title.en: Poisson PINN: independent grid error

summary.ja: 3固定seedの49パラメータPINNを解析解・FDと比較します。
summary.en: Compare a 49-parameter PINN for three fixed seeds with analytic and finite-difference solutions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元区間[0,1]で −uₓₓ=π²sin(πx)、u(0)=u(1)=0。中間層16素子・49実パラメータ、固定seed 8401–8403、学習64点と独立評価257点を用います。
assumptions.en: Solve dimensionless −uₓₓ=π² sin(πx) on [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data. Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points.

algorithm.ja: x(1−x)を掛けて境界値を厳密に組み込むtanhネットワークを、解析的な全パラメータJacobian付きTRF最小二乗法で学習します。固定予算後の全モデルを保存し、31/63/127未知数の2次中心差分とThomas法も計算します。
algorithm.en: Train a hard-boundary tanh ansatz with trust-region reflective least squares and an analytic parameter Jacobian. Retain every returned model under the fixed budget. Also solve second-order finite differences with 31, 63 and 127 unknowns using the Thomas algorithm.

validation.ja: 全49列の残差Jacobianと損失勾配、空間微分を別資格段階で独立照合。解析解sin(πx)に対する独立点誤差、PDE残差、境界値、FD誤差を別に保存します。収束・精度目標の実際の真偽を残し、正常な予算終了を収束と呼びません。
validation.en: Independently qualify all 49 residual-Jacobian columns, loss-gradient coordinates and spatial derivatives. Save off-training solution error against sin(πx), PDE residual, boundary error and finite-difference error separately. Preserve actual convergence and accuracy decisions; a normal budget return is not convergence.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
method_note.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

name.ja: 共役勾配法

summary.ja: 既存配布版：実対称正定値な連立一次方程式を共役方向で反復的に解く。公開例は単位正方形・零Dirichlet Poisson方程式の五点差分を、行列を組み立てずに扱う前処理なしCG。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Solve real SPD linear systems by conjugate directions. The public example is unpreconditioned matrix-free CG for the five-point zero-Dirichlet Poisson operator on a unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Hestenes, M. R. & Stiefel, E. (1952). Methods of Conjugate Gradients for Solving Linear Systems.
references.scope: Real SPD conjugate-gradient recurrence; not the heat time integrator used elsewhere in the chapter.

supports.ja: 実対称正定値系に対するCGの反復式と、丸め誤差がある場合の有限回終了の限界。
supports.en: CG recurrence for real SPD systems and the qualification of finite termination in floating-point arithmetic.

verification.locator: Sections 2–3, especially (3:1) and the discussion of rounding error, pp. 410–411.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.
Inner products are Euclidean array products; the current implementation starts from zero and has no preconditioner.
poisson_comparison.solve stops on a recomputed true relative residual; linear.poisson_2d uses a recurrence residual with tolerance×max(1,initial residual).
methods.units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
methods.boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. This CG example has no preconditioner, general sparse-matrix interface or pure-Neumann nullspace handling. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 作用素は実対称正定値で、右辺は有限。ここでは定係数の −Δu=f を一様正方格子で離散化する。
内積は配列成分のEuclidean内積。既存実装の初期値は零で、前処理は用いない。
poisson_comparison.solve は再計算した真の相対残差を停止に使う。linear.poisson_2d は反復残差と tolerance×max(1,初期残差) を使う。
methods.units_ja: CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。

problem.ja: Poisson方程式の離散化などから得られる、実対称正定値系 Ax=b。
problem.en: Real SPD systems Ax=b, including a discrete Poisson equation.

variant.ja: 五点差分作用素を直接適用する前処理なしの線形CG。共通比較経路では各反復で真の残差を再計算する。
variant.en: Unpreconditioned linear CG with a matrix-free five-point operator; the comparison path recomputes the true residual each iteration.

ja: SPDが分かっている離散系で、行列積だけから解を求めたいとき。
同じ格子・右辺・真の残差基準で他のPoisson解法と比較するとき。
en: The discretized system is known to be SPD and a matrix-free solve is desired.
Comparing Poisson solvers on the same grid, forcing and true-residual criterion.

反復回数だけで計算時間や連続解の精度を保証したい場合。
en: Nonsymmetric advection systems, saddle-point systems or periodic/Neumann systems with an untreated nullspace.
Claims about runtime or continuous-solution accuracy based only on iteration count.

reason.en: Inspected the CG recurrence, absence of preconditioning and two stopping rules.

reason.ja: CGの固有要件ではない。公開例の零Dirichlet条件は別途明記した。
reason.en: Not intrinsic to CG; the examples' zero-Dirichlet condition is separately stated.

reason.ja: SPDの要件と既存例の範囲に限定した。

summary.en: Inspected linear.poisson_2d, poisson_comparison.solve and existing tests for general-forcing discrete residuals, matched stopping criteria and the single-mode case; no rerun.

title.ja: 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ
title.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge

summary.ja: 特異な2D Poissonを互換条件と指定平均込みで解き、不適合な外力を拒否します。
summary.en: Solve singular2D Poisson with compatibility/gauge and reject incompatible source.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。
assumptions.en: Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe.

algorithm.ja: 共有面差分で特異行列を組み、体積重み平均のLagrange拘束付き疎直接法とcompatible CGを照合。物理的な不適合外力の平均を勝手に引かない。
algorithm.en: Shared-face differences, weighted-mean augmented solve and compatible CG comparison; no physical RHS mean projection.

validation.ja: L2細分化、零空間、平均、CG差、source+1拒否、境界流束/体積源の収支を保存。
validation.en: Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget.

limits.ja: 同じ半離散系の別線形解法は独立PDE参照ではありません。既存Dirichlet MGの成功や2D任意境界へ一般化しません。
limits.en: A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.

title.ja: 係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG
title.en: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG

summary.ja: 不連続係数のFV解を独立なP1参照と比較し、線形系の残差・前進誤差と連続問題の誤差を分けます。
summary.en: Compare discontinuous-coefficient FV with independent P1 reference fields, separating linear-system residual/forward errors from continuum error.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、零Dirichlet、f=1、対角2象限100/残り1、N16/32/64。参照P1は128/192。
assumptions.en: Unit square, zero Dirichlet, f=1, diagonal quadrants100/others1, N16/32/64; reference P1 meshes128/192.

algorithm.ja: 直交FVの共有面調和平均。幾何MGと座標を受け取らないSA-AMGの対称Galerkin V-cycleを、同じ行列のPCGへ適用。
algorithm.en: Orthogonal FV with shared harmonic transmissibility. Symmetric Galerkin geometric and coordinate-free SA cycles precondition PCG on identical matrices.

validation.ja: 非零2材料流束パッチ、残差に整合する収支、直接解の前進/energy誤差、独立三角形P1参照の格子感度。
validation.en: Nonzero two-material flux patch, residual-aware budget, direct forward/energy errors and independent triangular-P1 grid sensitivity.

limits.ja: 係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。
limits.en: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted.

summary.en: Existing releases: Geometric multigrid combines fine-grid smoothing with coarse-grid correction of smooth error. The public implementation is a fixed-hierarchy V-cycle for zero-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Brandt, A. (1977). Multi-Level Adaptive Solutions to Boundary-Value Problems.
references.scope: Multilevel interaction for boundary-value solvers; the atlas implements only a fixed nested-grid geometric V-cycle.

supports.ja: 粗密の格子間で情報を交換する多重格子法の一次研究。論文中の適応格子機能を実装済みとはしない。
supports.en: Primary multilevel boundary-value research; its adaptive capabilities are not claimed for the fixed-grid atlas example.

verification.locator: Abstract on printed p. 333 available in indexed primary-paper text; full PDF fetched but no readable body extracted. Author bibliography separately checked.

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
methods.units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights.
methods.boundary_conditions: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：固定された正方形・定係数・入れ子格子の教育例。AMG、不規則格子、適応細分化、強い異方性や不連続係数用の特別な平滑化は実装しない。Brandt論文の全機能や任意問題での最適計算量を示すものではない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: An educational fixed-square, constant-coefficient nested-grid example. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。
粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。
最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。

methods.boundary_conditions_ja: [0,1]² の全辺で u=0。誤差補正も零Dirichletで、ゼロ埋め込みにより境界値を入れる。

title.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系とSchur前処理

assumptions.ja: 速度12/24、圧力5/11の代数的混合Poisson/Stokes型ブロック。元の真の残差1e-9を共通基準にします。
assumptions.en: Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
algorithm.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.

validation.ja: LAPACK全系解、理想Schurの3点スペクトル、CGの明示的負曲率対照。
validation.en: Global LAPACK solutions, the analytic ideal-Schur spectrum and an explicit negative-curvature control for CG.

summary.ja: 非線形Jacobianを組み立てずにBratuの上下枝を3種類のJvで解き、forcingと実際の残差・評価回数を保存します。
summary.en: Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.

assumptions.ja: 同じ無次元1次元Dirichlet問題でλ=3、内点63/127、初期値0または4sin(πx)。3Jv×2格子×2枝の12解法と固定η=1e-8の解析Jv対照1本。GMRES restart24/max96、Newton最大24、残差許容1e-9です。
assumptions.en: The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
algorithm.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの129固定判定が合格。非零Jvの解析検算、離散残差、独立解析上下枝、3modeの一致、forcing、評価回数、Krylov記憶幅、Armijoと固定η対照を確認。解析forcing検算は別計数で、FD/ADの反復制御には使いません。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared27 pytest tests and this case’s129 fixed gates: nonzero analytic Jv qualification, discrete residuals, independent analytic branches, mode agreement, forcing, evaluation ledgers, Krylov storage, Armijo and the constant-eta control. Analytic forcing validation is counted separately and does not steer FD/AD iterations.

limits.ja: 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
limits.en: An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

title.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度
title.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

summary.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
summary.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

assumptions.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
assumptions.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

limits.ja: 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

title.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
title.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

summary.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
summary.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

assumptions.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
assumptions.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

algorithm.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

limits.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.en: Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning

scope.ja: 同じ元残差の基準でMINRESとGMRESを比較し、理想Schurの三点スペクトルを検査します。
scope.en: MINRES and GMRES use the same original-system residual criterion and are checked against the ideal Schur three-point spectrum.

method_note.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
method_note.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.

name.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov
name.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products

scope.ja: 非線形Jacobianを組み立てずにBratuの上下枝を3種類のJvで解き、forcingと実際の残差・評価回数を保存します。
scope.en: Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
method_note.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

scope.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
scope.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。 追加固定例：擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：同じ難しい初期値に対する線探索と信頼領域。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差、van der Polの短時間剛性遷移。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：酵素反応の保存と準定常近似。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve. Additional fixed examples: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Line search and trust regions from the same difficult starts. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold, Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error, Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. references.label: Armijo, L. (1966). Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives.

supports.ja: 十分減少と刻みの半減という考え方の根拠。原論文の最小化の収束定理を、この非線形方程式実装の保証とはしない。

verification.locator: Printed pp. 1–3; convergence theorem and Corollary 2, equation (2).

references.scope: Newton equations and approximate inner linear solves; context for the GMRES path, not proof of the atlas's particular forcing rule.

supports.ja: Newton方程式を近似的に解く定式化。今回確認したのは抄録であり、実装固有の内部許容誤差の定理適合は未確認。
supports.en: Formulates approximate Newton solves; only the abstract was reviewed, not a theorem audit of the implemented inner tolerance.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata, as returned by web search; direct full text not reviewed.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
methods.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
methods.boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
methods.units_ja: 固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。

problem.en: A differentiable square nonlinear system F(x)=0.

variant.ja: 残差ノルムのArmijo型十分減少を用いる減衰Newton。内部線形解法はdenseまたはGMRESで、Jacobianは明示指定。
variant.en: Damped Newton with an Armijo-type residual-norm decrease test; explicit Jacobian and dense/GMRES inner solve.

title.ja: 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える
title.en: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation

summary.ja: 同じ1次元Bratu境界値問題の下枝から上枝までを追跡し、接線・fold・独立解析族との空間誤差を調べます。
summary.en: Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family.

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

algorithm.ja: hΣdu²+dλ²の重み付き単位接線、予測点と接線超平面によるNewton補正。別の拡大系でfoldと正規化null vectorを解きます。このcaseは疎Jacobianを明示的に組み立てます。
algorithm.en: Use a unit tangent in h-sum(du squared)+d-lambda squared, a predictor and a tangent-hyperplane Newton corrector. A separate augmented system locates the fold and a normalized null vector. This case deliberately assembles sparse Jacobians.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの67固定判定が合格。離散残差、接線の向き・単位長、fold方程式・null条件・transversality、独立Decimal80解析族、固定3格子の誤差を別々に確認しています。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately.

limits.ja: 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
limits.en: A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

title.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度
title.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

summary.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
summary.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

assumptions.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
assumptions.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

title.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
title.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

summary.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
summary.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

assumptions.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
assumptions.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

algorithm.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

limits.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

caption.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

title.ja: Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差

summary.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references.

assumptions.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。
assumptions.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs.

algorithm.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。
algorithm.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result.

validation.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。
validation.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately.

limits.ja: 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
limits.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

title.ja: van der Polの短時間剛性遷移

summary.ja: 局所制御と大域誤差を分離します。初回は元209目標中208達成で、μ=1の厳しい適応設定は大域目標2e-5に未達でした。
summary.en: Separate local control from global error. The first study met 208 of 209 original targets; the mu = 1 tight adaptive run missed the 2e-5 global goal.

assumptions.ja: x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。
assumptions.en: The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. Two fixed methods, three step counts and two mu values plus four adaptive runs give 16 runs.

algorithm.ja: BDF2/SDIRK2と倍分割適応法。解析Jacobian・段階内だけの因子再利用・失敗時の候補保存を実装します。
algorithm.en: Use actual BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling, analytic Jacobians, factor reuse within each implicit stage, and retained candidates on failure.

validation.ja: 資格済みRadau/BDFと21時刻で比較。元の全判定を偽値も含め保存し、他208条件と、結果の忠実な表示・実局所制御・元失敗保存の3検証を別に要求します。
validation.en: Compare 21 sampled times with qualified Radau and BDF references. Preserve every original decision, including false values. Require the other 208 conditions separately from three checks of faithful disclosure, actual local controls and retained original failure evidence.

limits.ja: 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
limits.en: This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

title.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似
title.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA

summary.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。
summary.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

assumptions.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
assumptions.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

algorithm.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
algorithm.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

validation.ja: 独立な全系Radau/BDF参照、縮約式の陰的スカラー恒等式、E+C=E₀とS+C+P=1、正値性、実際の採用・棄却・Newton作業を照合。初期層を含む全時間と、事前指定θ≥0.02の近似誤差を別保存します。
validation.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

limits.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
limits.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

method_note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. title.ja: 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証
title.en: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification

summary.ja: 同じ非線形2次元Euler渦をN=16/32/64、背景Mach数.1/.01でT=.1まで進め、通常RoeとMiczek型の空間流束前処理を比較します。全12計算で、速度・動圧スケールの圧力誤差、保存収支、音響刻み、実段状態を調べます。
summary.en: The same nonlinear 2D Euler vortex is evolved to T=0.1 on N=16/32/64 at background Mach 0.1/0.01, comparing ordinary Roe with Miczek spatial flux preconditioning. Twelve fixed runs retain velocity and dynamically scaled pressure errors, conserved budgets, acoustic steps and actual stage states.

assumptions.ja: 領域[-10,10]²、周期境界、γ=1.4、β=3、背景ρ∞=1とU∞=(1,.5)。p∞=|U∞|²/(γM∞²)とし、流速と渦強度を固定して背景Mach数を変えます。M∞は局所最大Mach数ではありません。全平面の移動等エントロピー渦を最小像座標で評価し、有限周期箱のGaussian裾の継ぎ目を別に評価します。保存量のセル平均は8点Gauss求積で初期化・比較し、16点と照合します。閉形式の厳密セル平均や一般の厳密周期渦とは呼びません。
assumptions.en: Periodic [-10,10]^2, gamma=1.4, beta=3, background density 1 and velocity (1,0.5). Set p_infinity=|U_infinity|^2/(gamma M_infinity^2), retaining the same flow and vortex strengths. Background Mach is not maximum local Mach. A whole-plane translating isentropic vortex is evaluated with minimum-image coordinates and a separately qualified Gaussian seam. Conserved cell means use eight-point tensor Gauss quadrature, checked against order 16; they are not closed-form exact means or a generic exactly periodic nonlinear vortex.

algorithm.ja: 同じ無制限の中心原始変数MUSCL再構築・有限体積・物理Euler流束・SSPRK(3,3)を使い、Roe散逸だけをD=P⁻¹|PA|で前処理します。Roe平均の全流速Machからμ=min(1,max(Mlocal,M∞))、δ=1/μ−1とし、原始変数のMiczek行列を保存量へ変換します。行列絶対値は特性値ũn,ũn±τの2次多項式で作用させ、別の密行列固有分解と照合します。物理時間微分・音速は変えず、音響CFL=.2を使います。再構築した両面と各3段の正のρ,pを確認し、limiter・floor・状態修復・隠れた再試行・疑似時間反復はありません。前進Eulerの増幅反例を示すため、SSP・TVD・非線形安定性を名前だけで保証しません。
algorithm.en: Both finite-volume variants use the same unlimited centered primitive-MUSCL reconstruction,  the physical Euler flux and SSPRK(3,3); only Roe dissipation is replaced by D=P^-1|PA|. At each Roe state use the total-speed Mach with mu=min(1,max(M_local,M_infinity)) and delta=1/mu-1, applying the primitive Miczek matrix through conserved-variable Jacobians. A degree-two characteristic polynomial applies the matrix absolute value; a separate dense eigendecomposition checks it. Physical time and sound speed are unchanged; acoustic CFL=0.2 remains. Reconstructed faces and all three stages check positive density and pressure, without limiters, floors, repair, hidden retries or pseudo-time iteration. A forward-Euler amplification counterexample prevents claiming SSP/TVD or general nonlinear stability from the integrator name.

validation.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
validation.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

limits.ja: T=.1だけの短時間・少数格子の検証で、渦の一周や長時間保存を確認したものではありません。Fourier検査は指定した一様背景・離散波数・増幅回数の範囲であり、全波数や可変状態の非線形安定性・正値性の証明ではありません。実計算では音響CFLを維持し、対流刻みで進めたとは主張しません。定常解の加速、dual time、衝撃波・接触の頑健性、一般格子やMach数全域は未検証です。解析場の有限周期箱、Gauss求積、セル平均からの原始変数評価を区別し、圧力のMach依存や局所誤差を成功値だけに置き換えません。 無制限MUSCLは滑らかなこの入力の選択であり、limiter・TVD法・一般的な正値性保証ではありません。初版で現れた箱全体の圧力波を角の切り取りだけで隠さず、追加図で全領域の失敗を示します。 速度や固定コアの改善を圧力全域へ一般化できません。最細の全領域圧力L1は前処理側が少し大きく、M∞を10分の1にすると前処理の全域圧力誤差も増えています。圧力精度のMach独立性はこの実測から主張しません。運動エネルギー比は保存セル平均から求めた速度変動の診断で、連続場の運動エネルギーの厳密保存ではありません。
limits.en: This is a short T=0.1 fixed-input, few-grid test, not a full circulation or long-time preservation study. The Fourier check covers selected uniform states, wave numbers and powers; it is no proof for all modes, nonlinear variable states or general positivity. Actual integration retains the acoustic CFL and does not use the displayed convective diagnostic step. Steady convergence acceleration, dual time, shock/contact robustness, general meshes and all Mach numbers remain unverified. Finite periodic-box seams, Gauss quadrature and primitive variables evaluated from cell means remain distinct qualifications. Pressure Mach dependence and local errors are retained. Unlimited MUSCL is selected for these smooth inputs, not a limiter, TVD method or general positivity guarantee. The original box-wide pressure waves are shown in a separate full-domain failed-trial figure rather than hidden by the gallery core crop. Velocity/core improvements do not imply globally better pressure: finest whole-domain pressure L1 is slightly larger with preconditioning and grows when background Mach is reduced by ten. No Mach-independent pressure accuracy follows from these measurements. Perturbation kinetic energy is a diagnostic computed from conserved cell means, not exact conservation of continuous kinetic energy.

title.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較
title.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++

summary.ja: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。
summary.en: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、vz=Bz=0、t=0.05。rho=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(-sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(-sin2πy,sin4πx)/sqrt(4π)。
assumptions.en: Unit square, gamma=5/3, mu0=1, vz=Bz=0, t=0.05. rho=25/(36pi), p=5/(12pi), v=(-sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(-sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi).

algorithm.ja: 公開済みの1次Rusanov/前進Eulerを再利用。CTは共有corner EMFの離散curl、GLMはcell中心Bと双曲・放物型cleaning。Athena++は別実装のHLLD+PLM+RK2。
algorithm.en: Reuse the published first-order Rusanov/forward-Euler solvers: shared corner-EMF discrete curl for CT and cell-centered hyperbolic/parabolic GLM cleaning. Independent Athena++ uses HLLD, PLM and RK2.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²で密度とByのL1誤差、質量・エネルギードリフト、正値性を測定。独立参照は128²/256²でも収束を確認し、細胞平均を保存的に制限します。
validation.en: Measure density/By L1 error, mass/energy drift and positivity on 16²/32²/64². Check the independent 128²/256² reference and conservatively restrict its fine-cell averages.

limits.ja: CTの面上divergenceとGLMの中心差分divergenceは異なる演算子です。共通cell演算子の値も別記します。Athenaの初期磁場はベクトルポテンシャルの差分による面平均で、同じ連続場の離散化差を含みます。短時間の平面MHD比較であり、衝撃波・3D・UCTやCTUの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. This is a short planar test, not validation of shocks, 3D, UCT or CTU.

depth_scope.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。 CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。 Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。 CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。 追加の実際の2D磁場ループと衝撃波形成後Orszag–Tangで、edge EMFとface磁場のCT更新を使用。独立Athenaの有限格子参照と発散・エネルギーを別々に確認します。
depth_scope.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem. Additional actual2D magnetic-loop and postshock Orszag–Tang use edge EMFs and face-field CT updates. Separately check divergence/energy against finite-grid independent Athena references.

title.ja: CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束
title.en: CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium

summary.ja: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。
summary.en: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

assumptions.ja: 周期単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、平面MHD。A=.05[cos2π(x−.3t)+cos2π(y−.2t)]、B=(Ay,−Ax)、ρ=1、v=(.3,.2)、p=.1+(2π)²A²/2、t=.1。保存変数の解析的セル平均を比較します。公刊の標準問題名を借りない構成検証例です。
assumptions.en: Periodic unit square, gamma5/3, mu0=1, planar MHD. A=.05[cos2pi(x−.3t)+cos2pi(y−.2t)], B=(Ay,−Ax), rho1, v=(.3,.2), p=.1+(2pi)²A²/2 at t=.1. Compare analytic conserved cell averages. This is a constructed verification case, not a claimed published standard benchmark.

algorithm.ja: 両法とも区分定数・同じ固定Rusanov速度α=3・前進Eulerです。CTは面Bと共有算術corner EMF、GLMはcell B/ψとch=3・物理減衰率κ=2を使用。全格子で同じ384刻み、両法のdt列も同一です。CT面平均から復元した初期cell BとGLM初期Bが一致します。
algorithm.en: Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²の保存変数L1/L2/L∞誤差と観測次数を測ります。最細格子の刻み倍増差を空間誤差の.1以下と比較。時間収束は固定8²で16/32/64/128刻みを、許容誤差・最大刻みを二重に細分したDOP853へ照合します。質量・E、正値性、native CT divと共通cell div、ψも記録します。
validation.en: Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi.

limits.ja: 定数LLF粘性・周期中心演算子では、GLMのdiv=ψ=0部分空間は丸めまで保たれます。本例は結合MHDの精度を調べ、能動的cleaningは別の非物理診断対照で調べます。p(q平均)はpの厳密平均と同一ではありません。DOP853は時間だけ独立で空間RHSは共有します。刻み倍増差は経験的汚染目安で厳密誤差上界ではなく、CT/GLMの内部表現差を含む有限離散化全体の比較です。
limits.en: With constant LLF viscosity and periodic centered operators, the GLM div=psi=0 subspace remains invariant up to roundoff. This tests coupled-MHD accuracy; a separate nonphysical control activates cleaning. p(q-average) is not the exact averaged p. DOP853 is independent in time only and shares the spatial RHS. Step differences are empirical contamination indicators, not rigorous bounds; face/cell representation differences remain part of the comparison.

title.ja: Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束
title.en: Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references

summary.ja: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。
summary.en: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated.

assumptions.ja: 標準周期OT、γ=5/3、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(−sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(−sin2πy,sin4πx)/√(4π)、t=.05。16²/32²/64²の両法に192刻みを共用します。旧配布版を改変しない追加検証です。
assumptions.en: Standard periodic OT: gamma5/3, rho25/(36pi), p5/(12pi), v=(−sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(−sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi), t=.05. Both methods share192 steps on16²/32²/64². This supplements the previous immutable release.

algorithm.ja: 主計算は固定α=ch=3のRusanovと前進Euler、GLMκ=2は格子に依存しません。独立C++ Athena++はHLLD・PLM・RK2・upwind CTです。同じ連続初期値を用いますが、Athenaのface/primitive離散化は主計算と完全同一ではありません。
algorithm.en: Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical.

validation.ja: 密度・磁場L1誤差、格子改善、正値性、保存量とdiv/ψを測定。Athena256²/512²はともにCFL=.15、512²のCFL=.3/.15差で参照の時間感度を確認し、両増分が主計算誤差の.1以下か判定します。主計算の固定16²での時間収束を別実行DOP853へ照合し、最細格子の刻み倍増差も確認します。
validation.en: Measure density/magnetic L1 error, mesh improvement, positivity, conservation and div/psi. Athena256²/512² both useCFL.15; fixed512² CFL.3/.15 checks reference time sensitivity, with increments compared against.1 of primary error. At fixed16², compare primary time refinement with separately executed DOP853 and check finest-grid step doubling.

limits.ja: 短時間の滑らかなOTで、衝撃波後・3D・一般のcleaning性能の認証ではありません。独立Athena参照も有限格子数値解で、増分は誤差上界ではありません。旧128²/CFL.3は履歴だけで256²/CFL.15との組を純粋な格子次数に使いません。定数LLFによるGLMのdiv=ψ=0保存をcleaning成功とは呼びません。native面divと共通中心divを区別し、中心演算子のcheckerboard盲点も残します。
limits.en: Short smooth OT, not certification of post-shock,3D or general cleaning behavior. Athena is a finite-grid numerical reference; increments are not error bounds. Historical128²/CFL.3 is not paired with256²/CFL.15 to infer a pure spatial order. Constant-LLF preservation of GLM div=psi=0 is not evidence of active cleaning. Native face and common centered divergences differ; centered checkerboard blind spots remain.

title.ja: CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照
title.en: Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control

summary.ja: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。
summary.en: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem.

assumptions.ja: 32²周期格子、t=.1、128刻み、ρ=p=1、v=0、By=ψ=0。CT face Bx=.01cos[2π(i+1)/32]、GLM cell Bxはその左右face平均と同一です。CT初期native div≠0は意図的に無効な物理初期値で、CTの正しい物理計算例とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Periodic32² grid,t=.1,128 steps,rho=p=1,v=0,By=psi=0. CT faceBx=.01cos[2pi(i+1)/32]; GLM cellBx equals the adjacent-face average. The intentional nonzero native CT divergence violates valid physical CT initial data and is treated solely as a diagnostic.

algorithm.ja: 同じ完全結合MHDコードを使用。y不変・By=vy=0ではGLMのBx/ψ系が流体応答から独立するため、離散Fourier記号の2×2行列と前進Euler行列冪を別に構成します。κ=2とκ=0を同じdt・LLF粘性で比較し、Bxだけの減少を物理減衰と取り違えません。
algorithm.en: Use the same fully coupled MHD code. With y-invariance andBy=vy=0, the GLM Bx/psi subsystem decouples from fluid feedback, allowing a separately constructed2x2 discrete Fourier symbol and forward-Euler matrix power. Compare kappa2/0 at identical dt and LLF viscosity, separating B/psi phase exchange from physical damping.

validation.ja: CT native divの初期違反保持、GLMのψ励起、Bx/ψ双方の独立FE参照一致、密度・圧力正値性、物理的総E/質量保存を確認。補助波エネルギーW=〈Bx²+ψ²/ch²〉のκ2/κ0比を判定し、半離散行列指数と連続Fourier解も区別して表示します。
validation.en: Check preservation of the initial CT defect, nonzero GLM psi, independent FE agreement for bothBx/psi, positive density/pressure, and conserved physical E/mass. Test the kappa2/0 ratio of auxiliary wave energy W=mean(Bx²+psi²/ch²), separating FE, semidiscrete-exponential and continuum-Fourier references.

limits.ja: 対照の合格は「期待したCTの非除去とGLMの線形応答を正しく検出した」という意味です。非零CT divを許す物理計算を推奨しません。Wは診断用ノルムで、ψを含まない物理的総エネルギーEとは別です。GLMのBx減少には位相交換とLLF拡散も含まれ、κ0対照なしに減衰成功とは呼びません。一般非線形・境界流出・衝撃波のcleaning性能へ広げません。
limits.en: Passing means correctly detecting expected CT non-removal and the calibrated GLM response, not recommending non-solenoidal CT physical initial data. W is an auxiliary diagnostic norm, distinct from conserved physical total energy E without psi. B decay includes phase exchange and LLF diffusion; damping is assessed with the kappa0 control. No general nonlinear,boundary or shock cleaning guarantee is claimed.

title.ja: 磁場ループ：独立2次元参照と細分化
title.en: Magnetic loop: independent 2D reference and refinement

summary.ja: 実際の2次元磁場ループ輸送を、別実装Athena++の空間・時間感度を検査した終端保存場と比較します。
summary.en: Compare genuine 2D magnetic-loop transport with final conserved fields from independent Athena++, qualified in space and time.

assumptions.en: Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs.

algorithm.ja: 全8変数HLLD流束、MC-MUSCL再構成、固定刻みHeun。共有面流束とCT-contact角電場から面磁場を更新し、セル磁場は隣接面平均。初期状態は公式生成器の離散ベクトルポテンシャルと中心流体値に一致させます。
algorithm.en: Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. Shared face fluxes and CT-contact corner EMFs update native face B; cell B is adjacent-face averaged. Initial discrete vector-potential curl and sampled fluid states match the official generator.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。Athena++の2格子と刻み半減で参照を検定。終端保存変数を保守的に粗視化し、誤差と参照感度を分離します。共通セル発散と主計算の固有面発散は別の検査です。
validation.en: Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify Athena++ with two grids and a half-CFL probe. Conservatively restrict final conserved states and separate reference sensitivity from primary error. Common-cell divergence and primary native-face divergence are distinct checks.

Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation.

title.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較
title.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++

summary.ja: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。
summary.en: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、vz=Bz=0、t=0.05。rho=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(-sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(-sin2πy,sin4πx)/sqrt(4π)。
assumptions.en: Unit square, gamma=5/3, mu0=1, vz=Bz=0, t=0.05. rho=25/(36pi), p=5/(12pi), v=(-sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(-sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi).

algorithm.ja: 公開済みの1次Rusanov/前進Eulerを再利用。CTは共有corner EMFの離散curl、GLMはcell中心Bと双曲・放物型cleaning。Athena++は別実装のHLLD+PLM+RK2。
algorithm.en: Reuse the published first-order Rusanov/forward-Euler solvers: shared corner-EMF discrete curl for CT and cell-centered hyperbolic/parabolic GLM cleaning. Independent Athena++ uses HLLD, PLM and RK2.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²で密度とByのL1誤差、質量・エネルギードリフト、正値性を測定。独立参照は128²/256²でも収束を確認し、細胞平均を保存的に制限します。
validation.en: Measure density/By L1 error, mass/energy drift and positivity on 16²/32²/64². Check the independent 128²/256² reference and conservatively restrict its fine-cell averages.

limits.ja: CTの面上divergenceとGLMの中心差分divergenceは異なる演算子です。共通cell演算子の値も別記します。Athenaの初期磁場はベクトルポテンシャルの差分による面平均で、同じ連続場の離散化差を含みます。短時間の平面MHD比較であり、衝撃波・3D・UCTやCTUの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. This is a short planar test, not validation of shocks, 3D, UCT or CTU.

title.ja: GLMの磁気単極子モード：解析的減衰
title.en: GLM longitudinal mode: analytic damping

summary.ja: GLM cleaning単独の縦磁場Fourierモードを、連続線形方程式の行列指数解と比較します。
summary.en: Compare a longitudinal magnetic Fourier mode of GLM cleaning with the continuous linear matrix-exponential solution.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,1]、Bx=cos2πx、psi=0、ch=1、減衰κ=2、t=1。流体との結合を外した線形診断です。
assumptions.en: Periodic [0,1], Bx=cos2pix, psi=0, ch=1, damping kappa=2, t=1. This linear diagnostic omits fluid coupling.

algorithm.ja: ∂tBx=-∂xpsi、∂tpsi=-ch²∂xBx-κpsiを中心差分とRK4で積分。独立参照は連続Fourier記号の2×2行列指数です。
algorithm.en: Integrate Bx_t=-psi_x and psi_t=-ch² Bx_x-kappa psi with centered differences/RK4. The independent reference exponentiates the continuous 2x2 Fourier symbol.

validation.ja: 16/32/64点でL2誤差、空間2次収束、磁場divergenceモード振幅の減衰を判定します。
validation.en: Check L2 error, second-order spatial refinement and damping of the divergence-mode amplitude at 16/32/64 points.

limits.ja: この線形モードの減衰を、非線形MHDの全divergenceや大域的な精度の保証とはしません。CTで表せない単極子モードをCTとの同条件比較には用いません。
limits.en: Linear-mode damping does not guarantee divergence control or global accuracy for every nonlinear MHD problem. A monopole mode that CT cannot represent is not used as a matched CT comparison.

depth_scope.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。 GLMの磁気単極子モード：解析的減衰: GLM cleaning単独の縦磁場Fourierモードを、連続線形方程式の行列指数解と比較します。 CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。 Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。 CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。
depth_scope.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. GLM longitudinal mode: analytic damping: Compare a longitudinal magnetic Fourier mode of GLM cleaning with the continuous linear matrix-exponential solution. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem.

title.ja: CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束
title.en: CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium

summary.ja: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。
summary.en: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

assumptions.ja: 周期単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、平面MHD。A=.05[cos2π(x−.3t)+cos2π(y−.2t)]、B=(Ay,−Ax)、ρ=1、v=(.3,.2)、p=.1+(2π)²A²/2、t=.1。保存変数の解析的セル平均を比較します。公刊の標準問題名を借りない構成検証例です。
assumptions.en: Periodic unit square, gamma5/3, mu0=1, planar MHD. A=.05[cos2pi(x−.3t)+cos2pi(y−.2t)], B=(Ay,−Ax), rho1, v=(.3,.2), p=.1+(2pi)²A²/2 at t=.1. Compare analytic conserved cell averages. This is a constructed verification case, not a claimed published standard benchmark.

algorithm.ja: 両法とも区分定数・同じ固定Rusanov速度α=3・前進Eulerです。CTは面Bと共有算術corner EMF、GLMはcell B/ψとch=3・物理減衰率κ=2を使用。全格子で同じ384刻み、両法のdt列も同一です。CT面平均から復元した初期cell BとGLM初期Bが一致します。
algorithm.en: Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²の保存変数L1/L2/L∞誤差と観測次数を測ります。最細格子の刻み倍増差を空間誤差の.1以下と比較。時間収束は固定8²で16/32/64/128刻みを、許容誤差・最大刻みを二重に細分したDOP853へ照合します。質量・E、正値性、native CT divと共通cell div、ψも記録します。
validation.en: Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi.

limits.ja: 定数LLF粘性・周期中心演算子では、GLMのdiv=ψ=0部分空間は丸めまで保たれます。本例は結合MHDの精度を調べ、能動的cleaningは別の非物理診断対照で調べます。p(q平均)はpの厳密平均と同一ではありません。DOP853は時間だけ独立で空間RHSは共有します。刻み倍増差は経験的汚染目安で厳密誤差上界ではなく、CT/GLMの内部表現差を含む有限離散化全体の比較です。
limits.en: With constant LLF viscosity and periodic centered operators, the GLM div=psi=0 subspace remains invariant up to roundoff. This tests coupled-MHD accuracy; a separate nonphysical control activates cleaning. p(q-average) is not the exact averaged p. DOP853 is independent in time only and shares the spatial RHS. Step differences are empirical contamination indicators, not rigorous bounds; face/cell representation differences remain part of the comparison.

title.ja: Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束
title.en: Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references

summary.ja: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。
summary.en: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated.

assumptions.ja: 標準周期OT、γ=5/3、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(−sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(−sin2πy,sin4πx)/√(4π)、t=.05。16²/32²/64²の両法に192刻みを共用します。旧配布版を改変しない追加検証です。
assumptions.en: Standard periodic OT: gamma5/3, rho25/(36pi), p5/(12pi), v=(−sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(−sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi), t=.05. Both methods share192 steps on16²/32²/64². This supplements the previous immutable release.

algorithm.ja: 主計算は固定α=ch=3のRusanovと前進Euler、GLMκ=2は格子に依存しません。独立C++ Athena++はHLLD・PLM・RK2・upwind CTです。同じ連続初期値を用いますが、Athenaのface/primitive離散化は主計算と完全同一ではありません。
algorithm.en: Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical.

validation.ja: 密度・磁場L1誤差、格子改善、正値性、保存量とdiv/ψを測定。Athena256²/512²はともにCFL=.15、512²のCFL=.3/.15差で参照の時間感度を確認し、両増分が主計算誤差の.1以下か判定します。主計算の固定16²での時間収束を別実行DOP853へ照合し、最細格子の刻み倍増差も確認します。
validation.en: Measure density/magnetic L1 error, mesh improvement, positivity, conservation and div/psi. Athena256²/512² both useCFL.15; fixed512² CFL.3/.15 checks reference time sensitivity, with increments compared against.1 of primary error. At fixed16², compare primary time refinement with separately executed DOP853 and check finest-grid step doubling.

limits.ja: 短時間の滑らかなOTで、衝撃波後・3D・一般のcleaning性能の認証ではありません。独立Athena参照も有限格子数値解で、増分は誤差上界ではありません。旧128²/CFL.3は履歴だけで256²/CFL.15との組を純粋な格子次数に使いません。定数LLFによるGLMのdiv=ψ=0保存をcleaning成功とは呼びません。native面divと共通中心divを区別し、中心演算子のcheckerboard盲点も残します。
limits.en: Short smooth OT, not certification of post-shock,3D or general cleaning behavior. Athena is a finite-grid numerical reference; increments are not error bounds. Historical128²/CFL.3 is not paired with256²/CFL.15 to infer a pure spatial order. Constant-LLF preservation of GLM div=psi=0 is not evidence of active cleaning. Native face and common centered divergences differ; centered checkerboard blind spots remain.

title.ja: CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照
title.en: Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control

summary.ja: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。
summary.en: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem.

assumptions.ja: 32²周期格子、t=.1、128刻み、ρ=p=1、v=0、By=ψ=0。CT face Bx=.01cos[2π(i+1)/32]、GLM cell Bxはその左右face平均と同一です。CT初期native div≠0は意図的に無効な物理初期値で、CTの正しい物理計算例とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Periodic32² grid,t=.1,128 steps,rho=p=1,v=0,By=psi=0. CT faceBx=.01cos[2pi(i+1)/32]; GLM cellBx equals the adjacent-face average. The intentional nonzero native CT divergence violates valid physical CT initial data and is treated solely as a diagnostic.

algorithm.ja: 同じ完全結合MHDコードを使用。y不変・By=vy=0ではGLMのBx/ψ系が流体応答から独立するため、離散Fourier記号の2×2行列と前進Euler行列冪を別に構成します。κ=2とκ=0を同じdt・LLF粘性で比較し、Bxだけの減少を物理減衰と取り違えません。
algorithm.en: Use the same fully coupled MHD code. With y-invariance andBy=vy=0, the GLM Bx/psi subsystem decouples from fluid feedback, allowing a separately constructed2x2 discrete Fourier symbol and forward-Euler matrix power. Compare kappa2/0 at identical dt and LLF viscosity, separating B/psi phase exchange from physical damping.

validation.ja: CT native divの初期違反保持、GLMのψ励起、Bx/ψ双方の独立FE参照一致、密度・圧力正値性、物理的総E/質量保存を確認。補助波エネルギーW=〈Bx²+ψ²/ch²〉のκ2/κ0比を判定し、半離散行列指数と連続Fourier解も区別して表示します。
validation.en: Check preservation of the initial CT defect, nonzero GLM psi, independent FE agreement for bothBx/psi, positive density/pressure, and conserved physical E/mass. Test the kappa2/0 ratio of auxiliary wave energy W=mean(Bx²+psi²/ch²), separating FE, semidiscrete-exponential and continuum-Fourier references.

limits.ja: 対照の合格は「期待したCTの非除去とGLMの線形応答を正しく検出した」という意味です。非零CT divを許す物理計算を推奨しません。Wは診断用ノルムで、ψを含まない物理的総エネルギーEとは別です。GLMのBx減少には位相交換とLLF拡散も含まれ、κ0対照なしに減衰成功とは呼びません。一般非線形・境界流出・衝撃波のcleaning性能へ広げません。
limits.en: Passing means correctly detecting expected CT non-removal and the calibrated GLM response, not recommending non-solenoidal CT physical initial data. W is an auxiliary diagnostic norm, distinct from conserved physical total energy E without psi. B decay includes phase exchange and LLF diffusion; damping is assessed with the kappa0 control. summary.ja: 周期2Dの非線形渦を実際に時間発展し、連続解析場への速度・圧力・エネルギー誤差を保存します。amplitude感度と同格子のcoupled刻み感度も分けて示します。
summary.en: Evolve a nonlinear periodic2D vortex and save velocity/pressure/energy errors against the continuous analytic field. Distinguish amplitude probes from a fixed-grid coupled-step probe.

assumptions.ja: [0,2pi)²、ν.1、基本U.2、N24/32/64、dt=.2dx²、tau.56、T=.2pi²、144/256/1024steps。N32/U.4,.8とN32/U.2/dt=.1dx²/tau.53/512stepsを追加。初期圧力整合rhoを使用。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi)²,nu.1,baseU.2,N24/32/64,dt=.2dx²,tau.56,T=.2pi²and144/256/1024steps. Add N32/U.4,.8andN32/U.2/dt=.1dx²/tau.53/512steps. Use pressure-consistent initial density.

algorithm.ja: 標準BGKと完全周期streaming。p=cs²(rho−平均rho)(dx/dt)²で圧力単位とゲージを揃えます。解析場は初期値以外に注入せず、微分を独立Fourier演算で資格確認します。
algorithm.en: Standard BGK and fully periodic streaming. Convert/gauge pressure ascs²(rho−meanrho)(dx/dt)². No analytic field injection after initialization; independently qualify the continuum field by Fourier differentiation.

validation.ja: 22pytestと79判定、6固定発展。最細速度相対L2.03、圧力.08、combined速度次数1.5以上、エネルギー.03、発散・周期質量・平均運動量を判定。解析PDE5資格を区別して保存します。 最粗N16の初回エネルギー誤差5.0018%未達を保持し、同じ3%基準へ最粗だけN24へ細分化。次数は最細32/64対だけで評価します。
validation.en: 22pytest and79gates,sixfixed evolutions. Require finest velocity relativeL2.03,pressure.08,combined velocity order≥1.5,energy.03anddivergence/periodic mass/mean momentum. Save five analyticPDEqualifiers distinctly. Retain the initial N16energy failure5.0018%; refine only thatcoarsegrid to24against the unchanged3%gate. Report order only for thefinest32/64pair.

limits.ja: 拡散尺度では格子・時間・Machが結合し、amplitude変更はReも変えます。純空間/純時間/純Mach次数や有限Machの厳密非圧縮性を主張しません。平衡初期化のkinetic startupも実誤差へ含めます。

summary.en: Compare true-circle quadratic Lagrange link interpolation andstair halfway against analytic rotating-inner-wall Navier–Stokes flow; anadditional control distinct fromcylinderwake.

assumptions.en: Rin.2/Rout.4,center(.5,.5),inner tangential speed.02,stationary outerwall,nu.01. N80/160/240,tau.7,T4,integer3840/15360/34560steps; both boundaries give sixruns. Initialize equilibrium moments of the analytic field.

algorithm.ja: 円弧交点qから反射特性上の3点2次補間を行います。q<.5はoutgoingの内側2点、q>.5はincomingの内側1点を使用し、q=.5はhalfway。移動壁補正、実force/torqueと非零wall massを台帳化し、floorやmass補正をしません。
algorithm.en: Three-point quadratic interpolation on the reflected characteristic: twointerior outgoing samples forq<.5,oneinterior incoming sample forq>.5,exacthalfway atq=.5. Record movingwall correction,actual force/torque andnonzero wallmass; nofloor ormassrepair.

scope.ja: 固定された5ケース群のうち当該手法に対応する限定例です。 Gaussianの線形比体積畳み込み、対称な可変h、独立な対Riemann解と反対称な全エネルギー交換を持つGSPHです。通常SPHへp*を代入する代用ではありません。一次再構成に限定し、論文のcubic/MUSCLや一般精度を主張しません。 GSPH、摂動した128粒子、t=0.2。初期カーネル再構成誤差は最大0.011834で、音波振幅0.001より大きく、左の密度分布にその影響が残ります。右は初期誤差です。判定は基本Fourierモードの位相・振幅と保存量などの固定条件であり、点ごとの高精度や一般的な優位性を示しません。
scope.en: Only the named fixed examples in this five-case protocol. Actual Gaussian linear-specific-volume GSPH overlap with symmetric variable h, independent pair Riemann solves and antisymmetric total-energy exchange; not substitution of star pressure into ordinary SPH. First-order reconstruction only, not the paper cubic/MUSCL implementation or a general accuracy claim. GSPH with 128 jittered particles at t=0.2. The initial kernel reconstruction error reaches 0.011834, exceeding the acoustic amplitude 0.001 and remaining visible in the left density profile; the right panel shows that initial error. Acceptance concerns the fundamental Fourier mode phase/amplitude and other fixed conservation controls, not pointwise high accuracy or general superiority.

algorithm.en: Upwind relative flux(a-w)q advances actual masses with identical predictor/corrector face geometry; record stage volumes and Courant numbers.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：対象方程式・境界条件・検証の範囲は解説章と各コードを確認してください。教育用例は汎用ソルバーの完成を意味しません。 今回の追加固定例：1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 今回の追加固定例：離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: See the chapter and implementation for equations, boundaries and checked scope. Educational examples are not complete general-purpose solvers. Additional fixed examples: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions.
