algorithm.ja: 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。
algorithm.en: Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. Qualify the dielectric root using branch continuation/bracket checks and a separately derived, time-refined Volterra IVP with the same fixed-window estimator.

validation.ja: 31 pytest・19自己無撞着計算・140/140ケース判定・17/17独立線形参照資格判定が合格。pytest+mainは7.283秒。Landau粒子空間層256/512の曲線差.001154、振幅半減差.004376は固定.03以下。以前の64層版130/131（振幅差.05646>.03）は全データと元契約を保持した未達例です。入力の振幅と全許容値は維持しました。
validation.en: 31pytest,19self-consistent runs,140/140case gates and17/17independent linear-reference qualifiers passed; shared pytest+main7.283s. Landau256/512particle-space curve gap.001154 and amplitude-half gap.004376 meet the unchanged.03bound. Original64-strata130/131result (.05646>.03) remains an explicitly unmet retained example; amplitudes/all tolerances stayed fixed.

limits.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。
limits.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

algorithm.ja: 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。
algorithm.en: Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. Qualify the dielectric root using branch continuation/bracket checks and a separately derived, time-refined Volterra IVP with the same fixed-window estimator.

validation.ja: 31 pytest・19自己無撞着計算・140/140ケース判定・17/17独立線形参照資格判定が合格。pytest+mainは7.283秒。Landau粒子空間層256/512の曲線差.001154、振幅半減差.004376は固定.03以下。以前の64層版130/131（振幅差.05646>.03）は全データと元契約を保持した未達例です。入力の振幅と全許容値は維持しました。
validation.en: 31pytest,19self-consistent runs,140/140case gates and17/17independent linear-reference qualifiers passed; shared pytest+main7.283s. Landau256/512particle-space curve gap.001154 and amplitude-half gap.004376 meet the unchanged.03bound. Original64-strata130/131result (.05646>.03) remains an explicitly unmet retained example; amplitudes/all tolerances stayed fixed.

limits.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。
limits.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

case_notes.ja: 固定窓[12,20]の平均成長率.273111は同窓IVPの.273678と比較します。漸近分散根.284510に対する参照自身の過渡偏りは3.807%で、別判定として保持。T40の位相図は実際の後期応答の診断で、飽和精度の検証ではありません。
case_notes.en: Compare mean growth.273111 over[12,20] with the same-window IVP.273678. The reference itself has3.807%transient bias versus the asymptotic pole.284510, separately gated. The actualT40phase response is diagnostic, without a saturation-accuracy claim.

title.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合
title.en: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline

summary.ja: ベクトル化CIC/FFTと、別に書いた粒子ループCIC・密なDFTを、それぞれが自己無撞着な場を毎kick計算する軌道全体で照合します。
summary.en: Compare vectorized CIC/FFT with separately authored scalar-particle CIC/dense DFT; each trajectory sources its own field at every kick.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories.

algorithm.ja: 独立側はPythonスカラー配置、明示的な複素DFT和、独自の補間ループを所有します。主側のFFT・配置・補間を呼びません。数学上のCIC、Nyquist規約、velocity-Verlet法、初期配列は共通です。
algorithm.en: The independent path owns scalar deposition, explicit complex DFT sums and scalar gathering; it imports no primary spatial routines. Mathematical CIC, Nyquist convention, velocity-Verlet and initial arrays are intentionally shared.

validation.ja: 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。
validation.en: 19pytest and58/58fixed gates passed. Compare six pairs=twelve self-consistent trajectories at all13states; maximum differences:x8.88e-16,v3.33e-16,E8.33e-16,rho2.89e-15. Shared pytest+main.392s. Initial small pytest retained17/18with a periodic-index failure; integer wrapping was corrected before the first fixed main batch.

note.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。
note.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Eastwood, J. W. & Hockney, R. W. (1974). Shaping the force law in two-dimensional particle-mesh models.
references.scope: Primary PM charge-sharing/CIC and Fourier-force-shaping research in 2D; context for assignment and mesh-force errors, not a derivation of this 3D gravity implementation.

supports.ja: PMのCICを含む割当てと格子の力の誤差に直接関係する一次研究。2次元の論文であり、本実装の3次元Green関数を検証する文献とはしない。
supports.en: Directly supports PM assignment/CIC and mesh-force error context; this 2D paper is not a validation of the implemented 3D Green function.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata returned by web search; full text not reviewed.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
methods.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.

limitations.ja: 格子以下の近接力を直接補正しないPMのみの静的例。CIC平滑化、格子異方性・aliasing・有限解像度があり、連続Fourier Green関数を有限差分Laplacianの離散逆作用素と混同しない。P3M・TreePM分割・Ewald・PME/SPME・宇宙膨張・時間積分は含まない。
limitations.en: A static PM-only example without direct short-range correction. CIC smoothing, grid anisotropy, aliasing and finite resolution remain; the continuum Fourier Green function is not the inverse symbol of a finite-difference Laplacian. No P3M, TreePM split, Ewald, PME/SPME, expansion or time integration is included.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

CICは8隅への積線形重みで密度を作り、格子体積で割る。粒子へ戻す補間も同じ重み。CIC窓の逆補正は行わない。
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−平均ρ)、φ̂(0)=0。非零モードは −4πG/k²、加速度は−∇φ。偶数格子の微分は各軸の対応Nyquistモードを零にして実の奇作用素を保つ。

summary.ja: 既存配布版：孤立した3次元粒子の重力加速度をoctreeで近似する。公開例はG=1のPlummer軟化核に対し、質量単極子または同じ軟化核の完全な二次モーメント項を使い、直接和と比較する。 追加固定例：冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Approximate isolated 3D particle gravity with an octree. The public example uses G=1 and a Plummer-softened kernel, with a monopole or the same kernel's full second-moment term, compared with direct summation. Additional fixed examples: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

references.label: Barnes, J. & Hut, P. (1986). A hierarchical O(N log N) force-calculation algorithm.
references.scope: Octree hierarchical force evaluation; does not by itself document the atlas's full second-moment expansion of a Plummer-softened kernel.

supports.ja: 立方体を八分割する階層的な力計算の出典。今回確認した抄録から、軟化核や二次モーメント式の細部まで確認済みとはしない。
supports.en: Supports hierarchical octree force evaluation; the reviewed abstract does not establish the atlas's softened second-moment formula.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata returned by web search; full article body not reviewed.

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
methods.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。 今回の追加固定例：冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution. Additional fixed examples: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

title.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM
title.en: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L

summary.ja: 自由空間の対数ポテンシャルを一様四分木の多重極・局所展開で評価し、直接和と比較します。
summary.en: Evaluate a free-space log potential with uniform-quadtree multipole and local expansions and compare with direct sums.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形内の有限点電荷ですが、境界は壁でなく木を作る包囲領域です。核はphi=−sum(q log r)、電場は−grad(phi)。自己項を除外し、周期像はありません。
assumptions.en: Particles lie in a unit-square bounding box, not a physical wall boundary. The kernel is phi=−sum(q log r), with field −grad(phi); self terms are excluded and no periodic images are used.

algorithm.ja: 葉でP2M、上向きのM2M、相互作用リスト上のM2L、下向きのL2L、局所多項式の評価と近接P2Pを実装します。遠方を粒子ごとに開くBarnes–Hutへ置き換えず、移動演算回数と近接対数を記録します。
algorithm.en: Implement leaf P2M, upward M2M, interaction-list M2L, downward L2L, local-polynomial evaluation and near-field P2P. Record translation and near-pair counts; this is not a Barnes–Hut traversal relabeled as FMM.

validation.ja: 固定seedの128粒子で次数2・4・8・12を走査し、別の全対直接和とポテンシャル・電場の全成分を照合します。2点の符号、順序不変性、ポテンシャル微分も検査します。
validation.en: For 128 fixed-seed particles, sweep orders 2/4/8/12 and compare every potential/field component with a separate all-pairs calculation. Also check two-source signs, permutation invariance and potential derivatives.

limits.ja: 3次元1/r核、適応木、周期FMM、特異積分、実測の計算量スケーリングは未検証です。2次元自由空間の教育用実装として表示します。
limits.en: No 3D 1/r kernel, adaptive tree, periodic FMM, singular quadrature or empirical complexity/scaling study. Evidence applies to this 2D free-space educational implementation.

review_note.en: Institution-hosted reprint consulted for the log kernel, moments, three translations and up/down passes; 1997 reprint distinguished from 1987 original.

depth_scope.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM: 自由空間の対数ポテンシャルを一様四分木の多重極・局所展開で評価し、直接和と比較します。 FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。

title.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ
title.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth

summary.ja: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。
summary.en: Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

assumptions.ja: 自由空間のphi=−sum(q log r)、自己項なし。単位正方形は木の包囲領域で、壁・周期境界ではありません。3次元Coulomb核とは別です。
assumptions.en: Free-space phi=−sum(q log r), excluding self terms. The unit square bounds the tree and is not a wall or periodic boundary; this is separate from a 3D Coulomb kernel.

algorithm.ja: P2M/M2M/M2L/L2Lと近接P2Pを保ち、次数2/4/8/12、深さ2/3を比較します。別のCartesian直接和、二点電荷の閉形式、正多角形の中心力と遠方ポテンシャルを参照にします。
algorithm.en: Retain P2M/M2M/M2L/L2L and near P2P; compare orders 2/4/8/12 and depths two/three. References include independent Cartesian direct sums, a closed-form charge pair and regular-polygon radial/far-field identities.

validation.ja: ポテンシャル・場の最大絶対誤差、実際の遠方移動演算、回転・平行移動誤差、電荷を掛けた力の合計を測ります。粗い展開の失敗対照も確認します。
validation.en: Measure maximum absolute potential/field errors, actual far translations, rotation/translation differences and net charge-weighted force. Detect an inaccurate low-order control.

limits.ja: 木の深さによる相互作用の分割は変わるので、一定次数で深さに対する単調収束は要求しません。対象粒子ごとの展開は厳密な作用反作用を保証せず、3次元・適応木・周期FMM・計算量スケーリングは未検証です。
limits.en: Interaction repartition changes with depth, so fixed-order depth refinement is not assumed monotone. Target-wise expansions need not preserve exact action/reaction. No 3D, adaptive/periodic FMM or complexity-scaling claim.

review_note.ja: 著者所属機関の再録PDFで対数核、モーメント、3つの移動演算、上下走査を確認。再録版の掲載年1997と原著1987を区別。
review_note.en: Institution-hosted reprint consulted for the log kernel, moments, three translations and up/down passes; 1997 reprint distinguished from 1987 original.

title.ja: 真3D 1/r FMM：多段変換・力・適応所有権

summary.ja: 非圧縮Chebyshev FMMを真の葉レベル2/3と別の適応配置で実行し、独立直接和のポテンシャル・加速度と比較します。
summary.en: Run uncompressed Chebyshev FMM at actual leaf levels2/3 and a separate adaptive configuration; compare independent direct potentials and accelerations.

summary.en: Represent reference-interval functions in Legendre modes. The implementation tabulates P₀…Pₚ and derivatives, optionally normalizes them, and computes unweighted L2 projection and affine element matrices by Gauss quadrature.

verification.locator: Author preprint: Section 2, equations (1)–(18), and Section 3.1, equations (19)–(23); journal DOI/year/pages checked against publisher metadata.

assumptions: The reference interval is [−1,1] with weight one: ∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1); orthonormal=True multiplies by √((2k+1)/2).
Degree is a nonnegative integer. project_legendre approximates projection integrals by Gauss quadrature, leaving quadrature error for general functions.
Exact element-matrix quadrature means p+1 Gauss points for polynomial products with constant coefficients and an affine map.
methods.units: ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
methods.boundary_conditions: Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.

limitations.ja: 中程度の次数向けの教育用表作成で、高次数での安定性・最適化を保証しない。不連続関数では単一多項式の収束と求積が制約される。Chebyshev基底の重みをLegendreの重み1と混同せず、GLL求積による最高モードの質量を厳密質量と同一視しない。
limitations.en: Educational tabulation for modest degrees, without high-degree stability/performance guarantees. Discontinuities limit single-polynomial approximation and quadrature. Do not confuse Chebyshev weights with the unit Legendre weight, or GLL quadrature's highest-mode mass with exact mass.

name.ja: Lagrange節点基底・GLL選点法

summary.ja: 節点でδᵢⱼとなるLagrange基底により、関数を節点値から補間する。公開実装は区間のGLL/等間隔節点、三角形P1/P2、四角形Qₚの積基底と、GLLの厳密質量・求積集中質量の差を扱う。
summary.en: Interpolate from nodal values with Lagrange cardinal functions. The example covers interval GLL/equispaced nodes, triangle P1/P2, quadrilateral Qₚ products, and exact versus GLL-quadrature-lumped mass.

supports.ja: GLL節点のLagrange基底と、厳密質量行列・対角求積質量行列の差を参照する。三角形一般への公式とはしない。
supports.en: Supports GLL cardinal functions and exact versus quadrature-lumped interval mass; not a universal triangle formula.

verification.locator: Author preprint: Section 2, equations (1)–(18), and Section 3.1, equations (19)–(23); journal DOI/year/pages checked against publisher metadata.

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.
methods.units: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
methods.boundary_conditions: GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.

limitations.ja: 高次数のVandermonde解法は条件数の制約を受け、安定なbarycentric表作成や汎用高次要素の代替ではない。等間隔節点の高次補間にはRunge現象がある。GLL集中質量と厳密質量のrank-1差は重み1・アフィン区間での結果で、三角形全般へ適用しない。
limitations.en: High-degree Vandermonde solves face conditioning limits and are not a replacement for stable barycentric tabulation or a general high-order element library. High-degree equispaced interpolation can exhibit Runge behavior. The rank-one exact/lumped GLL mass difference concerns the unweighted affine interval, not arbitrary triangles.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 区間節点は相異なる有限実数で、中程度の次数を想定する。区間のLagrange多項式はLegendre Vandermonde行列を解いて評価する。
p≥1のGLL節点は両端±1とPₚ′の根。p+1点GLL求積は2p−1次まで厳密で、次数2pの質量積分は一般には厳密でない。
三角形は (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) のP1またはP2のみ。四角形は区間基底のQₚ積で、自由度数は(p+1)²。
methods.units_ja: 参照座標と基底は無次元、節点値は表す関数の単位。アフィン区間行列はJ=L/2により M∝J、K∝1/J。

title.ja: Brio–Wu：別実装HLLDとの照合
title.en: Brio–Wu against an independent HLLD implementation

summary.ja: 公開HLLD-MC有限体積コードを、固定コミットから別に構築したAthena++のBrio–Wu参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare the published HLLD-MC finite-volume code with Brio–Wu reference data independently produced by Athena++ at a pinned commit.

assumptions.en: 1D, [0,1], t=0.1, gamma=2, Bx=0.75; left/right (rho,p,By)=(1,1,1)/(0.125,0.1,-1), zero velocity, outflow boundaries.

algorithm.ja: アトラス側はMC再構成とSSPRK2、参照は独立C++のHLLD・PLM・RK3。異なる実装ですがHLLDという数値流束の系列は共有します。
algorithm.en: Atlas uses MC reconstruction and SSPRK2; the independent C++ reference uses HLLD, PLM and RK3. Implementations differ while sharing the HLLD flux family.

validation.ja: 128/256/512セルを、2048/4096セルで再実行した独立参照の保存的細胞平均と比較。rho/ByのL1誤差、格子改善、密度・圧力正値性を判定します。
validation.en: Compare 128/256/512 cells with conservative averages of independently rerun 2048/4096-cell references. Check density/By L1 errors, refinement and positive density/pressure.

limits.ja: Brio–Wuの複合波を含む数値解との照合であり、一般MHD Riemann問題の唯一の厳密解とは呼びません。参照の再生成にはC++コンパイルが必要で、通常Python実行は同梱参照を使います。
limits.en: This compares numerical solutions including the Brio–Wu compound wave; it is not a claim of a unique exact solution for arbitrary MHD Riemann problems. Reference regeneration requires C++ compilation; routine Python runs use the stored reference.

title.ja: 円偏波Alfvén波：全成分の格子収束
title.en: Circular Alfven wave: full-state refinement

summary.ja: 全8保存変数を進め、非零のBz・vzを含む円偏波を解析セル平均と比較します。
summary.en: Evolve all eight conserved variables and compare circular polarization, including nonzero Bz/vz, against analytic cell means.

assumptions.ja: γ=5/3、[0,1]周期、ρ=1、p=.1、Bx=1、振幅.1、速度1、T=1、32/64/128セル。初期値と参照は保存変数の解析セル平均であり、セル平均から復元する圧力は点の定圧と区別します。
assumptions.en: gamma5/3, periodic[0,1], rho1,p.1,Bx1,amplitude.1, speed1,T1,32/64/128 cells. Initialize/reference conserved analytic cell means; pressure recovered from means differs from constant pointwise pressure.

algorithm.ja: 全8変数HLLD流束、MC-MUSCL再構成、固定刻みHeun。Bx一定の1次元有限体積更新。
algorithm.en: Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. One-dimensional finite-volume update with constant Bx.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。解析保存平均を独立Gauss16求積と照合し、横成分誤差・位相・観測次数を検査します。
validation.en: Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify conserved analytic means by independent Gauss16 quadrature; measure transverse errors, phase and observed order.

limits.ja: 少数の固定入力に対する教育用検証です。HLLDのHLLE代替と再構成の正値性スケーリングを数え、セル状態の床・クリップ・再試行は行いません。有限格子参照は厳密解ではなく、任意問題の安定性・正値性や普遍的次数を保証しません。1次元整列波の次数であり、斜め2次元伝播の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. The observed order is for a 1D aligned wave, not oblique 2D propagation.

title.ja: 磁場ループ：独立2次元参照と細分化
title.en: Magnetic loop: independent 2D reference and refinement

summary.ja: 実際の2次元磁場ループ輸送を、別実装Athena++の空間・時間感度を検査した終端保存場と比較します。
summary.en: Compare genuine 2D magnetic-loop transport with final conserved fields from independent Athena++, qualified in space and time.

assumptions.en: Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs.

algorithm.ja: 全8変数HLLD流束、MC-MUSCL再構成、固定刻みHeun。共有面流束とCT-contact角電場から面磁場を更新し、セル磁場は隣接面平均。初期状態は公式生成器の離散ベクトルポテンシャルと中心流体値に一致させます。
algorithm.en: Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. Shared face fluxes and CT-contact corner EMFs update native face B; cell B is adjacent-face averaged. Initial discrete vector-potential curl and sampled fluid states match the official generator.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。Athena++の2格子と刻み半減で参照を検定。終端保存変数を保守的に粗視化し、誤差と参照感度を分離します。共通セル発散と主計算の固有面発散は別の検査です。
validation.en: Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify Athena++ with two grids and a half-CFL probe. Conservatively restrict final conserved states and separate reference sensitivity from primary error. Common-cell divergence and primary native-face divergence are distinct checks.

limits.ja: 少数の固定入力に対する教育用検証です。HLLDのHLLE代替と再構成の正値性スケーリングを数え、セル状態の床・クリップ・再試行は行いません。有限格子参照は厳密解ではなく、任意問題の安定性・正値性や普遍的次数を保証しません。独立比較は終端のみ。中間Athena時刻は指定四半時刻直後で、正確に整列した場とは表示しません。Athenaの固有面発散は出力しておらず測定を主張しません。密度比は圧縮の診断であり数学的衝撃波の証明ではありません。
limits.en: Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. Independent comparisons are final-only. Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation.

This demonstrates refinement against a finite-grid reference, not a precision exact-solution error. Primary native-face divergence is at most1.45e-16; the common cell operator is nonzero.

title.ja: 後期Orszag–Tang：独立参照と圧縮構造
title.en: Late Orszag-Tang: independent reference and compression structure

summary.ja: 圧縮性理想MHDのOrszag–TangをT=.2まで進め、相互作用する圧縮・衝撃波構造の密度と圧力を独立有限格子参照で検査します。
summary.en: Evolve compressible ideal-MHD Orszag-Tang to T.2 and check density/pressure in interacting compression/shock structure against an independent finite-grid reference.

assumptions.ja: γ=5/3、[-.5,.5]²周期、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、vx=sin2πy、vy=−sin2πx、Az=(cos4πx−2cos2πy)/(4π√(4π))、16/32/64²セル。原著の非圧縮・粘性抵抗モデルの再現ではありません。
assumptions.en: gamma5/3,periodic[-.5,.5]²,rho25/(36pi),p5/(12pi),vx=sin2piy,vy=-sin2pix,Az=(cos4pix-2cos2piy)/(4pi sqrt4pi),16/32/64² cells. This does not reproduce the original incompressible viscous/resistive model.

algorithm.ja: 全8変数HLLD流束、MC-MUSCL再構成、固定刻みHeun。共有面流束とCT-contact角電場から面磁場を更新し、セル磁場は隣接面平均。初期状態は公式生成器の離散ベクトルポテンシャルと中心流体値に一致させます。
algorithm.en: Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. Shared face fluxes and CT-contact corner EMFs update native face B; cell B is adjacent-face averaged. Initial discrete vector-potential curl and sampled fluid states match the official generator.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。Athena++の2格子と刻み半減で参照を検定。終端保存変数を保守的に粗視化し、誤差と参照感度を分離します。共通セル発散と主計算の固有面発散は別の検査です。
validation.en: Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify Athena++ with two grids and a half-CFL probe. Conservatively restrict final conserved states and separate reference sensitivity from primary error. Common-cell divergence and primary native-face divergence are distinct checks.

limits.ja: 少数の固定入力に対する教育用検証です。HLLDのHLLE代替と再構成の正値性スケーリングを数え、セル状態の床・クリップ・再試行は行いません。有限格子参照は厳密解ではなく、任意問題の安定性・正値性や普遍的次数を保証しません。独立比較は終端のみ。中間Athena時刻は指定四半時刻直後で、正確に整列した場とは表示しません。Athenaの固有面発散は出力しておらず測定を主張しません。密度比は圧縮の診断であり数学的衝撃波の証明ではありません。
limits.en: Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. Independent comparisons are final-only. Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
methods.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
methods.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.

limitations.ja: 5次は滑らかな領域での空間精度であり、時間は3次。不連続近傍で同じ次数は期待できず、ε・尺度・基底の影響を受ける。段階で非正値になると時間刻みを半減して再試行するが、これは正値性の定理ではない。WENO分岐はHLLCを使わず、有限体積PPM/MUSCL用の正値再構成スケーリングも使わない。
limitations.en: Fifth order refers to smooth-region spatial accuracy; time accuracy is third order. The same order is not expected near discontinuities, and ε, scaling and basis matter. Invalid stages trigger step halving and retries, which do not constitute a positivity theorem. The WENO branch uses neither HLLC nor the positive-reconstruction scaling used by the finite-volume PPM/MUSCL branch.

summary.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
summary.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 局所多項式のセル中心x=0、再構成面h/2、h=1/64…1/512を使います。輸送は[0,1]周期・速度1・q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)、T=1、32/64/128セルです。全て有限体積セル平均であり、点値を誤差の参照にしません。
assumptions.en: Local polynomials have center x=0 and target h/2, h=1/64…1/512. Transport uses periodic[0,1], unit speed, q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx), T=1 and32/64/128 cells. All evolved states/references are FV cell means, not point samples.

algorithm.ja: 3候補と線形重み(.1,.6,.3)、Jiang–Shu指標を共通にし、JSはd/(β+ε)²、Zはd[1+(|β₀−β₂|/(β+ε))²]を正規化します。ε=10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h²です。輸送は共有風上面流束と古典RK4、Courant.1を使い、状態クリップ・再試行を行いません。
algorithm.en: Share three candidates, linear weights(.1,.6,.3) and JS indicators. Normalize JS d/(beta+epsilon)² or Z d[1+(|beta0−beta2|/(beta+epsilon))²]. Use epsilon10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h². Actual transport uses shared upwind face fluxes and classical RK4 at Courant.1 without state clipping/retries.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で72局所再構成・24PDE計算・36pytestを固定します。解析セル平均を独立Gauss12求積と照合し、局所の誤差・重み、輸送のL1/L2/L∞・質量・全段有限性・中間時刻と保存流束を記録します。最細格子で6通りの刻み半減差が対応する連続解誤差の10%以下か確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors.

limits.ja: 一次臨界点の面再構成だけに次数判定を置き、二次臨界点は診断値として残します。固定εは解の振幅・単位に依存します。局所再構成の次数とPDE全体の次数、有限体積版と原著の有限差分版を区別します。衝撃波、Euler/MHD、一般の高次臨界点、任意入力の安定性・TVD・正値性は今回の保証に含めません。
limits.en: Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed.

formulas: (p_0,p_1,p_2)=\frac16(2\bar q_{i-2}-7\bar q_{i-1}+11\bar q_i,-\bar q_{i-1}+5\bar q_i+2\bar q_{i+1},2\bar q_i+5\bar q_{i+1}-\bar q_{i+2})

summary.ja: 既存配布版：中性周期セルのEwald和と独立theta積分: 3次元周期Coulomb相互作用の実空間和・逆空間和・自己項を実装し、分割パラメータと打切りを変えて検証します。 Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。 追加固定例：中性長方形スラブ：真2P参照とYB補正。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral: Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs. Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation. Additional fixed examples: Neutral rectangular slab: genuine2P reference and YB. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.
Omit only i=j in the same cell (n=0); retain periodic self images and account separately for the self-energy correction.
Specify splitting, real cutoff and reciprocal/mesh parameters. The mean-potential gauge and the macroscopic surface convention are different choices.
methods.units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
methods.boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：中性周期セルのEwald和と独立theta積分: 非中性セル、背景補正、非直交セル、誘電率が有限の表面項、スラブ補正、応力、物質固有の力場は扱いません。 Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分: 固定した中性立方セルだけです。上限感度は厳密な全配置の裾誤差保証ではありません。theta参照は別定式化の自作実装であり、第三者計算パッケージや公表された参照数表ではありません。非中性・非直交・スラブ・応力・長時間MDは対象外です。 今回の追加固定例：中性・固定4電荷・Cartesian z法線のみ。YBは有限ギャップ近似で任意真空の厳密2Pではありません。原著YB本文は未読。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral: No charged-cell/background correction, triclinic cell, finite-dielectric surface term, slab correction, stress or material-specific force field. Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration: One fixed neutral cubic cell. Upper-limit sensitivity is not a rigorous tail bound for arbitrary configurations. The theta reference is an independently formulated original implementation, not an external package or published numerical table. Charged/triclinic/slab cells, stress and long MD are outside scope. Additional fixed examples: Neutral fixed4charge Cartesian-z slab only. YB is a finite-gap approximation, not exact2P at arbitrary vacuum. Original Yeh full text not inspected.

title.ja: 中性周期セルのEwald和と独立theta積分
title.en: Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral

summary.ja: 3次元周期Coulomb相互作用の実空間和・逆空間和・自己項を実装し、分割パラメータと打切りを変えて検証します。
summary.en: Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs.

assumptions.ja: 立方セル・全電荷ゼロ・Coulomb定数1・導体境界（tin foil）。主例は非対称な8点電荷で、NaClの8イオン配置は別の解析照合用です。
assumptions.en: Cubic cell, zero total charge, Coulomb constant one and conducting/tin-foil boundary. An asymmetric eight-charge case is distinct from the eight-ion NaCl reference cell.

algorithm.ja: erfcで減衰する実空間和、Gaussian係数を持つ構造因子の逆格子和、−alpha/sqrt(pi) sum(q²)を加えます。力は各項の位置微分から求め、24成分を中心エネルギー差分と比較します。
algorithm.en: Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences.

validation.ja: 分割alphaを3点、実空間打切りを3点、逆空間打切りを4点で確認。NaClのMadelung定数は3次元和を呼ばない独立な1次元Jacobi-theta積分と照合し、求積の誤差推定も保存します。
validation.en: Three splitting parameters, three real cutoffs and four reciprocal cutoffs. Check the NaCl Madelung constant against a separately implemented 1D Jacobi-theta integral, storing its quadrature error estimate.

limits.ja: 非中性セル、背景補正、非直交セル、誘電率が有限の表面項、スラブ補正、応力、物質固有の力場は扱いません。
limits.en: No charged-cell/background correction, triclinic cell, finite-dielectric surface term, slab correction, stress or material-specific force field.

title.ja: Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分
title.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration

summary.ja: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。
summary.en: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation.

assumptions.ja: Coulomb定数1、単位立方体の3次元周期、全電荷0、tin-foil境界。旧版と同じ非対称配置です。独立参照も同じ零モードと自己項の規約を使います。
assumptions.en: Coulomb constant one; unit cubic 3D periodic neutral cell with tin-foil boundary. The asymmetric configuration matches the earlier example; reference zero-mode and self conventions match the model.

algorithm.ja: erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。
algorithm.en: Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces.

validation.ja: 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。
validation.en: Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control.

limits.ja: 固定した中性立方セルだけです。上限感度は厳密な全配置の裾誤差保証ではありません。theta参照は別定式化の自作実装であり、第三者計算パッケージや公表された参照数表ではありません。非中性・非直交・スラブ・応力・長時間MDは対象外です。
limits.en: One fixed neutral cubic cell. Upper-limit sensitivity is not a rigorous tail bound for arbitrary configurations. The theta reference is an independently formulated original implementation, not an external package or published numerical table. Charged/triclinic/slab cells, stress and long MD are outside scope.

summary.en: Compare corrected orthorhombic3P Ewald energy/all forces against a separately implemented genuine2P series.

assumptions.ja: Coulomb定数1、Lx1,Ly1.25、Lz1.5/3/6、4電荷±1、非周期zのMz=.34、alpha3/4。
assumptions.en: Coulomb1, lateral1×1.25, extendedLz1.5/3/6,4neutral charges±1,physical-z dipole.34 andalpha3/4.

algorithm.ja: 全±3D波数、自己項、2pi Mz²/Vとその力。独立2Pには横零モード・自己減算と安定exp–erfcを保持。

validation.ja: 参照alpha/打切り資格、エネルギー差分、真空厚、全力、零モード負対照・遠方ゲージと中性平行移動を分離。

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.
Omit only i=j in the same cell (n=0); retain periodic self images and account separately for the self-energy correction.
Specify splitting, real cutoff and reciprocal/mesh parameters. The mean-potential gauge and the macroscopic surface convention are different choices.
The original PME uses piecewise Lagrange interpolation and FFT convolution; specify interpolation order, mesh sizes and the grid-gradient convention.
methods.units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
methods.boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

limitations.ja: Bスプラインsmooth PMEの格子・次数収束: 有限格子のaliasingにより、エネルギー勾配型の合力は厳密にはゼロでなく、その診断量を保存します。運動量保存・長時間MD・原法PME・最適化P³M・スラブ補正の検証ではありません。 SPME：格子・補間次数・格子位相と保存則: エネルギー勾配型では有限格子のaliasingにより合力は一般にゼロではありません。厳密な運動量保存や任意配置での同じ誤差、長時間MD、原法PME、SPME全変種の検証とはしません。
limitations.en: Mesh/order convergence of B-spline smooth PME: Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed. SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation: Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified.

assumptions_ja: 最初の検証仕様は、立方体セル内の重なりのない点電荷と3次元周期Coulomb相互作用です。総電荷はゼロとし、一様中和背景は含めません。
同一粒子の同一セル項（i=j, n=0）のみを除外し、自己の周期像との相互作用は残します。自己エネルギー補正を別に扱います。
分割係数・実空間打切り・逆空間または格子条件を明示します。静電ポテンシャルの平均をゼロにする選択と、巨視的な表面項の境界規約は別です。
元のPMEとして、区分Lagrange補間とFFT畳み込みを採ります。補間次数・格子数・格子上の勾配評価を比較条件に含めます。
methods.units_ja: 比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。

summary.ja: 電荷をBスプラインで格子へ割り当て、FFTでEwald逆空間項を評価するsmooth PME（SPME）の小規模例です。
summary.en: A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT.

assumptions.ja: Ewaldと同じ中性立方セルと実空間項を使います。PME族のうちEssmannらのBスプライン変種を採用し、Dardenらの原法のLagrange補間とは区別します。
assumptions.en: The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。
algorithm.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

validation.ja: 16³・24³・40³格子と2つの次数で、直接Ewald逆空間和との差を記録します。Ewaldと実空間項・自己項を共有する部分も明示。最細格子の力はエネルギー差分とも比較し、全電荷の保持を確認します。
validation.en: Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge.

limits.ja: 有限格子のaliasingにより、エネルギー勾配型の合力は厳密にはゼロでなく、その診断量を保存します。運動量保存・長時間MD・原法PME・最適化P³M・スラブ補正の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed.

summary.en: Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force.

assumptions.ja: 同じ中性周期8電荷、alpha=5.6、実空間像3。PME族のEssmann型SPMEであり、1993年のLagrange補間の原法とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。
algorithm.en: Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation.

validation.ja: 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。
validation.en: Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control.

limits.ja: エネルギー勾配型では有限格子のaliasingにより合力は一般にゼロではありません。厳密な運動量保存や任意配置での同じ誤差、長時間MD、原法PME、SPME全変種の検証とはしません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified.

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.
Omit only i=j in the same cell (n=0); retain periodic self images and account separately for the self-energy correction.
Specify splitting, real cutoff and reciprocal/mesh parameters. The mean-potential gauge and the macroscopic surface convention are different choices.
Approximate structure factors with cardinal B-splines and matching Fourier correction/FFT normalization. Fourth-order (cubic) interpolation is an initial comparison candidate, not implemented code.
methods.units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
methods.boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

assumptions_ja: 最初の検証仕様は、立方体セル内の重なりのない点電荷と3次元周期Coulomb相互作用です。総電荷はゼロとし、一様中和背景は含めません。
同一粒子の同一セル項（i=j, n=0）のみを除外し、自己の周期像との相互作用は残します。自己エネルギー補正を別に扱います。
分割係数・実空間打切り・逆空間または格子条件を明示します。静電ポテンシャルの平均をゼロにする選択と、巨視的な表面項の境界規約は別です。
構造因子をcardinal B-splineで近似し、補間のFourier補正とFFT規格化を揃えます。最初の比較候補は4次（3次多項式）補間ですが、未実装です。
methods.units_ja: 比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。

summary.ja: 電荷をBスプラインで格子へ割り当て、FFTでEwald逆空間項を評価するsmooth PME（SPME）の小規模例です。
summary.en: A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT.

assumptions.ja: Ewaldと同じ中性立方セルと実空間項を使います。PME族のうちEssmannらのBスプライン変種を採用し、Dardenらの原法のLagrange補間とは区別します。
assumptions.en: The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。
algorithm.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

validation.ja: 16³・24³・40³格子と2つの次数で、直接Ewald逆空間和との差を記録します。Ewaldと実空間項・自己項を共有する部分も明示。最細格子の力はエネルギー差分とも比較し、全電荷の保持を確認します。
validation.en: Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge.

limits.ja: 有限格子のaliasingにより、エネルギー勾配型の合力は厳密にはゼロでなく、その診断量を保存します。運動量保存・長時間MD・原法PME・最適化P³M・スラブ補正の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed.

assumptions.ja: 同じ中性周期8電荷、alpha=5.6、実空間像3。PME族のEssmann型SPMEであり、1993年のLagrange補間の原法とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。
algorithm.en: Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation.

validation.ja: 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。
validation.en: Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control.

limits.ja: エネルギー勾配型では有限格子のaliasingにより合力は一般にゼロではありません。厳密な運動量保存や任意配置での同じ誤差、長時間MD、原法PME、SPME全変種の検証とはしません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified.

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.
Separate angular momentum l and solve for the reduced radial orbital u(r), normalized by integral |u|^2 dr=1.
Released inputs use Z=1,2 and (n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2); these cases do not cover arbitrary many-electron states.
A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).
methods.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 一般の多電子Schrödinger方程式の直接解法、時間発展、分子、周期系、相対論・核運動・スピン軌道相互作用は未実装。小さい離散固有値残差だけでは格子・領域誤差は除けず、有限差分の固有値は連続問題の変分上界とは限らない。
limitations.en: Not a general many-electron, time-dependent, molecular, periodic or relativistic solver; nuclear motion and spin–orbit effects are absent. Small discrete eigenpair residuals do not remove grid/domain error, and finite-difference eigenvalues are not guaranteed variational upper bounds to continuum energies.

metadata_review.level: method-specific primary-source and released-code inspection; saved 2026-11-21 results read; no new numerical run

assumptions_ja: 孤立・無限質量の点核によるCoulomb場−Z/r中の1電子。非相対論・外場なし。
角運動量lを分離し、∫|u|²dr=1で規格化した縮約動径軌道u(r)を解く。
公開入力はZ=1,2および(n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2)。任意の多電子状態を検証したものではない。
一様な内部動径格子と、2次の運動エネルギー差分による実対称三重対角行列を用いる。
methods.units_ja: 原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。公開する水素型の格子検査はr_max=60 bohr。Z=1の1sは別途r_max=4,8,16,32 bohrを比較。原点の正則性と無限遠の減衰を有限箱のDirichlet条件で近似する。

caution.ja: 核運動、相対論、スピン軌道相互作用、外場はこの代表式に含めません。固有値の残差が小さくても、領域・基底の誤差は残ります。
caution.en: Nuclear dynamics, relativity, spin–orbit coupling and external fields are outside this representative Hamiltonian. A small eigenpair residual does not establish domain or basis convergence.

example_scope.ja: 孤立水素型原子の1s・2s・2p・3dを一様動径格子で検証。多電子Schrödinger方程式全体の直接解法ではありません。

N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble. Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2. No physical lattice-constant or metal mapping.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
methods.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: この局所交換の簡約を多軌道・開殻・分子・周期系へそのまま拡張できない。原子版ではUHF/ROHF・分子積分・軌道安定性解析を扱わない。保存PySCF RHF参照は独立な有限Gaussian基底計算であり、相関を含むHeの厳密エネルギーではない。格子・箱幅・SCF収束と物理モデル誤差を区別する。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。
limitations.en: The local exchange reduction cannot be transferred unchanged to multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems. The atomic edition does not implement UHF/ROHF, molecular integrals or orbital-stability analysis. Saved PySCF RHF references are independent finite-Gaussian-basis calculations, not exact correlated helium energies. Separate grid, domain and SCF convergence from physical model error. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented.

assumptions_ja: 従来の原子例：Z=2の孤立He、無限質量の点核、非相対論。逆スピンの2電子が同じ球対称1s空間軌道を占有する。
従来の原子例：∫|u|²dr=1とし、p=2|u|²=4πr²n、∫p dr=2と定義する。
従来の原子例：この占有軌道に限り有効場は−2/r+v_H/2、交換エネルギーはE_x=−E_H/2に簡約される。一般の非局所Fock演算子は実装していない。
従来の原子例：単一行列式の交換を含み、電子相関を含まない。
別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
methods.units_ja: 原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: He縮約軌道にu(0)=u(r_max)=0（基本r_max=16 bohr、別途4/8/12/16 bohrの領域検査）。Hartree場は原点で有限、密度の外ではN/rへ接続し、r_maxで0には固定しません。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。

caution.ja: HFの解は一般に一意とは限りません。SCFが停止しても基底収束・軌道安定性・正しい電子状態の確認が必要です。分子解離では単一参照の限界が現れます。
caution.en: HF solutions need not be unique. SCF termination does not prove basis convergence, orbital stability or the desired electronic state. Bond dissociation can expose single-reference limitations.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Ground-state nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2 and one doubly occupied spherical 1s Kohn–Sham orbital.
Atomic/molecular examples: p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n and integral p dr=2, with n the total positive electron-number density of both spins.
Atomic/molecular examples: The adopted approximation is E_x[n]=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r, v_x=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), and E_c=v_c=0.
Atomic/molecular examples: The effective field is -2/r+v_H+v_x; second-order radial differences and simple density mixing solve this restricted model.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：厳密汎関数の理論とDirac交換のみという近似を区別する。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybrid、スピン分極、分子、周期バンド計算、励起は未実装。格子収束や独立な同一モデルとの一致は汎関数の物理精度を保証しない。KS固有値を一般の励起エネルギーと同一視しない。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Separate exact-functional theory from the adopted Dirac exchange-only approximation. LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids, spin polarization, molecules, periodic bands and excitations are not implemented. Grid convergence or agreement with an independent implementation of the same model does not establish functional accuracy. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The fixed-point map is the released spherical He 1s² HF or exchange-only LDA radial model, not a general molecular or periodic SCF implementation.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Mix input and output radial number densities: p_next=(1-alpha)p_in+alpha p_out, 0<alpha<=1; released baseline alpha=0.35 and an alternative start uses 0.7.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Each eigenproblem normalizes u and sets p_out=2|u|^2, so the electron-number normalization is imposed within the iteration.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Convergence requires input/output density L1<1e-9 electrons, |energy change|<1e-10 hartree, and the output-density-rebuilt orbital residual<1e-7 hartree; maximum 300 iterations.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The atlas iteration implements no DIIS, Anderson or Newton acceleration. An independent PySCF reference may use its own solver algorithms.

Atomic/molecular examples: Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：エネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しない。電子数が2に保たれることは実装の整合性検査であり、独立な物理検証ではない。異なる初期値での一致も解の一意性・軌道安定性・大域的最低エネルギーを証明しない。Pulay文献は未採用の加速法の文脈用で、単純密度混合の実装出典ではない。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Energy change alone is insufficient. Electron number staying at two is an imposed consistency check, not independent physical validation. Agreement from alternative starts does not prove uniqueness, orbital stability or a global energy minimum. The Pulay reference is context for an unimplemented acceleration method, not the source of the simple density-mixing implementation. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：固定点写像は公開する球対称He 1s²のHFまたは交換のみLDA動径モデルであり、汎用の分子・周期系SCF実装ではない。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：入力・出力の動径電子数密度をp_next=(1−α)p_in+αp_out（0<α≤1）で混合。公開基本値α=0.35、別の初期値では0.7も用いる。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：各固有値問題でuを規格化しp_out=2|u|²とするため、電子数の規格化は反復内で課している。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：密度の入出力L1差<10⁻⁹電子数、|エネルギー変化|<10⁻¹⁰hartree、出力密度で再構成した軌道残差<10⁻⁷hartreeをすべて要求。最大300反復。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：アトラス側の反復にDIIS・Anderson・Newton加速は未採用。独立PySCF参照は独自のソルバーを使いうる。
原子・分子の実行例：別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
methods.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：混合率αと反復回数は無次元。pはbohr⁻¹、∫|p_out−p_in|drは電子数、エネルギー変化と規格化した軌道残差はhartree。公開公差はこの規格化とモデルに対する値。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：SCF混合そのものに空間境界条件はない。与えたHe固定点写像が縮約軌道u(0)=u(r_max)=0と、原点で有限・遠方N/rの孤立Hartree場を規定する。HF・KS・Hartree項目を参照。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

caution.ja: 小さいエネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しません。収束した解が最低エネルギーの安定な電子状態である保証も別に検査します。
caution.en: A small energy change alone is insufficient. Convergence also does not establish the lowest-energy stable electronic solution.

ja: 小さなHeモデルで混合率・初期値・停止基準を比較する。

en: Compare mixing rates, starts and stopping criteria in a small helium model.
Distinguish process completion from convergence, including an intentional one-iteration failure.

ja: 金属・難収束系や汎用分子SCFで、この混合率と公差が常に適切とみなす。
反復が停止した事実だけで安定性・最低エネルギー・物理精度を保証する。
en: Assuming the same mixing and tolerances are generally suitable for metals, difficult systems or molecular SCF.
Using iteration termination alone to establish stability, minimum energy or physical accuracy.

reason.ja: heliumの密度更新式、停止の3条件と反復上限を確認。
reason.en: Inspected helium's density update, three stopping criteria and iteration cap.

reason.ja: 混合率の無次元性と残差ごとの単位・規格化を明記。
reason.en: Specified dimensionless mixing and normalization/units of each residual.

reason.ja: 混合アルゴリズム自体には境界がなく、Heの固定点写像が空間境界を与える。

summary.ja: 従来の原子コード点検の記録：既存公開版の実装・検査・保存結果を読んだ点検であり、この点検では再実行していません。heliumの入力密度混合・3条件の収束判定、初期値比較とmax_iterationsの検査、保存反復履歴・意図的未収束を確認。 H₂の新しい実行・独立参照・収束記録は別配布版を参照。 周期Heの新しいライブラリ実行検証は別記録に掲載。
summary.en: Historical atomic-code inspection: This inspection reads the released implementation, tests and saved results; it does not rerun the calculation. Inspected helium's input-density mixing and joint stopping test, alternative-start/max_iterations tests, saved histories and intentional nonconvergence. New H₂ execution, independent-reference and convergence receipts are supplied separately. New library-backed periodic-He validation is recorded separately.

helium mixing, alternative start, three tolerances and iteration limit

en: At the earlier inspection: No new run or verification of DIIS/Anderson/Newton methods or periodic-metal convergence.
At the earlier inspection: No exhaustive stationary-solution or orbital-stability analysis.

periodic_scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
periodic_scope.en: Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.

force_scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

title.ja: 最小基底H2のRHF/UHF/FCI・2固定幾何
title.en: Minimal-basis H2: RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI

summary.ja: 同じ最小基底H2の2固定幾何で、RHF/UHF/有限基底FCIとスピン対称性を比較します。
summary.en: Compare RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI for H2 at two fixed geometries in the same minimal basis.

assumptions.ja: H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。
assumptions.en: Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function.

algorithm.ja: 固定SCFでRHFと対称性を破ったUHFを求め、4x4二電子Hamiltonianを対角化します。
algorithm.en: Run fixed SCF and diagonalize the4x4 two-electron Hamiltonian using the unchanged explicit H STO-3G contraction.

validation.ja: 保存PySCF RHF2値、独立g/u変分多項式・FCI閉形式・fermion組立と照合します。
validation.en: Check two saved PySCF RHF energies, an analytic paired g/u variational polynomial, the even2x2 FCI block and independent fermion assembly.

limits.ja: UHFはスピン混入を持ちます。2幾何だけで完全な解離曲線や連続空間の厳密解を保証しません。
limits.en: Only two H2 geometries and two contracted s orbitals; no complete-basis dissociation curve. UHF is spin contaminated; FCI exactness is finite-basis only.

title.ja: 3中心H3+の小RHF/MP2/FCI模型
title.en: A tiny three-center H3+ RHF / MP2 / FCI example

summary.ja: 固定三角形H3+の3中心小分子で、RHF/MP2/有限基底FCIを示します。
summary.en: Demonstrate RHF, MP2 and finite-basis FCI for a tiny fixed three-center H3+ molecule.

assumptions.ja: H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。
assumptions.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.

algorithm.ja: 正準RHFから2電子MP2と9x9 FCIを求め、保存軌道から密度の2D断面を描画します。
algorithm.en: Canonicalize RHF, evaluate the two-electron MP2 correction and9x9 FCI, and render the saved occupied-orbital density slice.

validation.ja: 独立fermion組立、MP2行列要素の摂動式、電子数・SCF残差・FCI変分性を確認します。
validation.en: Check independent signed-fermion assembly, determinant perturbation MP2, electron number, SCF stationarity and FCI variational ordering.

limits.ja: 一般分子DFT・CC・一般多参照法は未実装です。MP2は変分的でなく、外部独立エンジンの新参照値も生成しません。
limits.en: General molecular DFT, CC, large bases and general multireference methods remain unimplemented. Independent operator assembly is not an independent external chemistry-engine scalar reference.

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
methods.units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Use the total spin-unpolarized positive number density n=n_up+n_down, with n_up=n_down=n/2; in the radial example n=p/(4 pi r^2).
Atomic/molecular examples: The implemented exchange is E_x=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r and v_x=delta E_x/delta n=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), hence E_x=(3/4) integral p v_x dr.

methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

example_scope.ja: スピン非偏極Dirac交換のエネルギーと汎関数微分のみを検証。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybridは解説のみ。

variant.ja: スピン非偏極Dirac交換のみ（LDA_X）。E_c=0、p=4πr²nを介した動径積分でE_xとv_xを同時に返す。
variant.en: Spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange only (LDA_X), E_c=0; radial integration through p=4 pi r^2 n returns consistent E_x and v_x.

ja: 同じ密度・スピン規約でエネルギーと汎関数微分の整合を学ぶ。

en: Study consistency between energy and its functional derivative under one density/spin convention.
Compare independent implementations of the same exchange-only model and separate numerical from model errors.

ja: 相関を含む汎関数、スピン分極、GGA・meta-GGA・hybridの結果が必要。

en: Requiring correlation, spin polarization, GGA, meta-GGA or hybrid results.
Using helium LDA_X agreement as a general functional or molecular/solid accuracy guarantee.

reason.ja: lda_exchangeのn=p/(4πr²)、交換係数、E_c=0と参照のLDA_X指定を確認。
reason.en: Checked n=p/(4 pi r^2), exchange coefficient, E_c=0 and reference LDA_X settings.

reason.ja: nとpを区別し、汎関数微分と全エネルギーに同じ規約を適用。
reason.en: Distinguished n/p and used one convention for the functional derivative and total energy.

reason.ja: 局所汎関数は密度を評価するだけで、空間境界はHeの軌道問題が供給。
reason.en: The local functional evaluates a supplied density; the helium orbital problem supplies boundaries.

reason.ja: 採用したLDA_Xと文献上のGGA/meta-GGA/hybridを区別。
reason.en: Distinguished adopted LDA_X from literature-only GGA/meta-GGA/hybrid coverage.

summary.ja: 既存公開版の実装・検査・保存結果を読んだ点検であり、この点検では再実行していません。lda_exchange、同一エネルギーの汎関数微分を摂動で調べる検査、保存済みLDA_X独立比較と明示的な参照汎関数指定を確認。 周期Heの新しいライブラリ実行検証は別記録に掲載。
summary.en: This inspection reads the released implementation, tests and saved results; it does not rerun the calculation. Inspected lda_exchange, a perturbation test of the same energy's functional derivative, saved independent LDA_X comparisons and explicit reference-functional settings. New library-backed periodic-He validation is recorded separately.

N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble. Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2. No physical lattice-constant or metal mapping.

algorithm.ja: rank1核のHermitian行列を解き、固定NのFermi占有と自由エネルギーの力を計算します。

validation.ja: 独立3次式固有値、Hermiticity・電子数・entropy・解析力と自由エネルギー差分を照合します。

limits.en: The authored rank-one kernel is not an element-fitted norm-conserving pseudopotential. No self-consistent Hartree/XC, real metal, general material or long-time MD success.

references.label: Monkhorst, H. J.; Pack, J. D. (1976), Special points for Brillouin-zone integrations
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Fixed neutral simple-cubic He cell, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X + LDA_C_VWN (VWN5), selected local GTH potential.
Uniform Gamma-centered 3D fractional k meshes and weights are explicit in input.
This is an original PySCF driver and validation workflow, not an independently authored DFT engine. Independent reference is separately executed DFTK.
methods.units: Atomic units: bohr, inverse bohr, hartree per neutral primitive cell; k fractions use reciprocal-lattice coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Three-dimensional Bloch periodic boundary conditions; explicit neutral one-atom cell, two electrons.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 選択した局所GTHと固定Heセルでの実行例に限定。非局所・PAW・他元素への移植性、金属・smearing、完全基底極限や実験値との一致は未検証。k点はBZ積分用で、バンド経路とは区別。
limitations.en: Limited to a selected local GTH and fixed He cell. Nonlocal/PAW/general-element transferability, metals/smearing, a complete-basis limit and agreement with experiment are unvalidated. BZ quadrature meshes are distinct from band paths.

metadata_review.level: scoped library-backed periodic-He execution and independent-reference checks; general-material validation is not implied

scope.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

caution.en: A small truncation measure does not establish the physical adequacy of an active space. Separate finite-bond-dimension error from active-space and basis error.

name.ja: Yee FDTD

summary.ja: Yee FDTDの真空・Fresnel界面・PMLと一次元の損失・Lorentz分散板を固定入力で検証。 追加固定例：2D誘電体円柱のMie散乱幅。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Lorentz分散板へのs/p斜め入射。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Fixed-input Yee FDTD checks for vacuum, Fresnel interfaces, PML and 1D lossy/Lorentz slabs. Additional fixed examples: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.
