references.scope: Original split-field PML publication: bibliographic identity and abstract checked. Original full text was not available for inspection. The implemented reduction and discrete balance are derived and tested separately; consult Johnson for the matched-layer interpretation.

references.label: Steven G. Johnson (2021). Notes on Perfectly Matched Layers (PMLs)
references.scope: Author notes, selected sections3.4,4.1–4.2 and7.1–7.3: independent x/y coordinate stretches and simultaneous corner damping, matching electric/magnetic rates, anisotropic interpretation, discretization reflections and incidence limitations. Not a complete audit of every PML formulation.

references.label: Markus Zahn (2003). Electromagnetic Field Theory: A Problem Solving Approach
references.scope: Author textbook, selected sections 7-6-1/7-6-2 (printed pp522–524), 7-9-1 (pp538–540), and 7-9-3/7-9-4 (pp541–544): normal/oblique Fresnel amplitudes, Snell and critical angles, evanescent fields, p-polarized Brewster condition and normal-power weighting. Field/sign conventions are adapted explicitly. Not an original Fresnel publication or a full-book audit. Selected sections 7-2-1 and 7-6-3 additionally consulted for conducting waves, complex wavenumber and conducting-interface context; the finite Lorentz slab and midpoint energy law are derived separately.

references.label: Meep developers (accessed 2026). Materials — official documentation
references.scope: Official HTML, selected Material Dispersion, Loss and Gain, and Conductivity and Complex ε sections: Lorentz polarization equation and exp(−iωt) convention. Meep uses a D-conductivity convention; this example instead uses conventional σE. Its explicit-ADE resonance stability bound is not attributed to our implicit midpoint update. No Meep numerical comparison or full documentation audit.

assumptions: New r6: linear isotropic passive nonmagnetic finite slabs in vacuum, 1D normal incidence, one Lorentz resonance or Ohmic conduction. Earlier TMz/TEz cases retained.
methods.units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields.
methods.boundary_conditions: New r6: distant PEC caps, no PML, aligned half-volume slab interfaces and vacuum monitors. Earlier periodic/PEC and PML examples retained.

limitations.ja: 教育用Yee FDTD。真空・Fresnel界面・s/p偏光・PMLの既存例を保持し、第6版で一次元垂直入射のOhmic・受動Lorentz板を追加。帯域解析解、反射・透過・直接散逸・物質蓄積、修正離散収支・物理流束と格子・時間収束を分けて検査。一般分散、多共鳴、斜め分散入射、分散PML、一般2/3次元の包括的検証ではない。 追加固定例：Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。 追加固定例：任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。 追加固定例：有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
limitations.en: Educational Yee FDTD: retained vacuum/Fresnel/s-p/PML examples plus r6 1D normal-incidence Ohmic and passive Lorentz slabs. Spectral references, R/T, direct dissipation, material storage, modified/physical budgets and space/time refinement are separate checks. Not blanket validation of general dispersion, multiple resonances, oblique dispersive incidence, dispersive PML or general 2D/3D. Additional fixed examples: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials. Additional fixed examples: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed. Additional fixed examples: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

title.ja: 2D誘電体円柱のMie散乱幅
title.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

summary.ja: 実際の2D散乱場を進め、閉曲線Poynting流束と独立な円柱級数を比較します。
summary.en: Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series.

assumptions.ja: c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。
assumptions.en: Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry.

algorithm.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
algorithm.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

validation.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
validation.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

limits.ja: Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
limits.en: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

title.ja: Lorentz分散板へのs/p斜め入射
title.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

summary.ja: 有限波束の実進行から複素r/t・R/T・直接散逸を求め、複素Fresnel参照と比較します。
summary.en: Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references.

assumptions.ja: 周期y方向のky=4に制限した2D場、c=1。板[4,5]のε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。外側は真空、PEC端は[-24,36]、T=60です。
assumptions.en: Use a two-dimensional field restricted to periodic transverse wave number ky = 4 and c = 1. The slab [4, 5] has epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Outer vacuum ends at PEC caps [-24, 36]; T = 60.

algorithm.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
algorithm.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

validation.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
validation.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

limits.ja: 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
limits.en: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

title.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
title.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

summary.ja: 80度の中心位相角を持つ有限波束をT=700まで進め、境界誤差を同格子の無PML参照から分離します。
summary.en: Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid.

assumptions.ja: c=1、均質Lorentz媒質ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12はPML内まで連続。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時に細分化します。垂直粗格子はpeak6、弱減衰細格子対照はpeak12。長さ64、層幅12、中心32、幅4、carrier6は固定です。
assumptions.en: Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed.

algorithm.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
algorithm.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

validation.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
validation.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

limits.ja: 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
limits.en: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

The revised, predeclared peak proportional to N keeps peak times h fixed and targets the finite-layer/cap floor; every original gate and bound remains unchanged.

Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error. Additional fixed examples: Warm PIC linear Landau damping, Warm PIC two-stream initial growth. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動: 有限振幅・有限粒子数の誤差床があります。非線形不安定性、Landau減衰、衝突、電磁PIC、相対論粒子、境界流入出の検証ではありません。 PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音: DOP853は独立PIC空間実装ではありません。電荷・運動量の保持とエネルギーの近似保存を区別し、初期雑音のNスケーリングを時間発展した熱プラズマの保証としません。Landau減衰・電磁PIC・相対論・衝突は未検証です。 今回の追加固定例：1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 今回の追加固定例：離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC: Finite amplitude and finite particles leave an error floor. Nonlinear instabilities, Landau damping, collisions, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and open particle boundaries are unvalidated. PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise: DOP853 is not an independent PIC spatial implementation. Distinguish charge/momentum preservation from approximate energy conservation. Initial-noise N scaling does not validate evolved warm plasmas. Landau damping, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and collisions remain unvalidated. Additional fixed examples: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Additional fixed examples: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit.

title.ja: CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動
title.en: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC

summary.ja: 1次元周期セルの電子をCICで格子と結び、Poisson方程式と粒子運動を自洽に進めます。
summary.en: Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently.

assumptions.ja: 長さ2pi、電子の電荷質量比−1、静止イオン背景密度1、plasma frequency=1の無次元系。quiet startから振幅0.001の微小正弦変位を与えます。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless length 2pi, electron charge/mass −1, stationary ion density one and plasma frequency one. A quiet start receives a small sinusoidal displacement of amplitude 0.001.

algorithm.ja: CIC電荷割当てと同じ重みの場補間、ゼロ平均のスペクトルPoisson解、速度Verletを組み合わせます。実数の奇微分の規約により、電場のNyquistモードはゼロにします。
algorithm.en: Combine CIC deposition and matching field gathering, a mean-zero spectral Poisson solve and velocity Verlet. Set the field Nyquist mode to zero for a real skew-adjoint spectral derivative.

validation.ja: 32・64・128格子の系列と、別の512格子上の時間刻み系列を分けます。変位モードを連続線形理論のcos(t)と比較し、全電荷・Poissonポテンシャル残差・単一粒子の自己力を検査します。
validation.en: Separate a 32/64/128-grid sweep from timestep refinement on a 512 grid. Compare displacement amplitude with continuum linear cos(t), and check charge compatibility, potential-Poisson residual and single-particle self force.

limits.ja: 有限振幅・有限粒子数の誤差床があります。非線形不安定性、Landau減衰、衝突、電磁PIC、相対論粒子、境界流入出の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite amplitude and finite particles leave an error floor. Nonlinear instabilities, Landau damping, collisions, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and open particle boundaries are unvalidated.

title.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音
title.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise

summary.ja: 冷たい1次元周期プラズマのquiet-start収束と、独立seedでの初期粒子雑音を分け、電荷・運動量・Gauss則・エネルギー誤差を保存します。
summary.en: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error.

assumptions.ja: 長さ2pi、静止イオン密度1、電子q/m=−1、plasma frequency=1、微小正弦変位0.001、最終時刻1.6。格子系列は同じ2048粒子を使い、時間系列は同じ32格子・256粒子を使います。 w=2pi/Nは粒子重み、nは格子数です。
assumptions.en: Length 2pi, stationary unit-density ions, electron q/m=−1, plasma frequency one, sinusoidal displacement 0.001 and final time 1.6. Mesh runs retain 2048 particles; time runs retain a 32-cell mesh and 256 particles. The particle weight is w=2pi/N and n is the grid count.

algorithm.ja: CIC割当て・同じ重みの場補間・スペクトルPoisson・速度Verlet。独立な時間積分法DOP853は同じ粒子格子RHSを積分し、参照自身の最大刻み感度を検査します。
algorithm.en: CIC deposition/matched gathering, spectral Poisson and velocity Verlet. The independent time algorithm DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS; compare its own maximum-step refinements.

validation.ja: 16/32/64格子とdt=.2/.1/.05を別に精密化し、線形cos(t)と時間参照の誤差を分離します。実数奇微分のNyquist零モードはGauss残差から分けて記録。時刻0の64seed・N=256/1024/4096のCICモード電力を解析期待値と比較します。
validation.en: Refine 16/32/64 grids and dt=.2/.1/.05 separately; distinguish continuum cos(t) from time-reference errors. Record the real odd derivative’s Nyquist null mode separately from Gauss residuals. Compare time-zero CIC mode power at 64 seeds and N=256/1024/4096 with its analytic expectation.

limits.ja: DOP853は独立PIC空間実装ではありません。電荷・運動量の保持とエネルギーの近似保存を区別し、初期雑音のNスケーリングを時間発展した熱プラズマの保証としません。Landau減衰・電磁PIC・相対論・衝突は未検証です。
limits.en: DOP853 is not an independent PIC spatial implementation. Distinguish charge/momentum preservation from approximate energy conservation. Initial-noise N scaling does not validate evolved warm plasmas. Landau damping, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and collisions remain unvalidated.

citations.review_scope: Read Gauss–Hermite normal quadrature definition, exp(-x²/2) weight and degree2n-1 polynomial exactness. Used only for positive full-f initial particle weights; no Hermite PDE time evolution.

review.ja: 公式1.14.1文書の重みと多項式積分次数を確認。初期粒子重みだけに用います。
review.en: Pinned official quadrature definition read; initialization only.

algorithm.ja: 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。
algorithm.en: Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. Qualify the dielectric root using branch continuation/bracket checks and a separately derived, time-refined Volterra IVP with the same fixed-window estimator.

validation.ja: 31 pytest・19自己無撞着計算・140/140ケース判定・17/17独立線形参照資格判定が合格。pytest+mainは7.283秒。Landau粒子空間層256/512の曲線差.001154、振幅半減差.004376は固定.03以下。以前の64層版130/131（振幅差.05646>.03）は全データと元契約を保持した未達例です。入力の振幅と全許容値は維持しました。
validation.en: 31pytest,19self-consistent runs,140/140case gates and17/17independent linear-reference qualifiers passed; shared pytest+main7.283s. Landau256/512particle-space curve gap.001154 and amplitude-half gap.004376 meet the unchanged.03bound. Original64-strata130/131result (.05646>.03) remains an explicitly unmet retained example; amplitudes/all tolerances stayed fixed.

limits.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。
limits.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

formulas: \partial_t f+v\partial_x f-E\partial_v f=0,\quad\partial_x E=1-\int f\,dv,\quad\langle E\rangle=0

title.ja: 温かいPICの線形Landau減衰
title.en: Warm PIC linear Landau damping

summary.ja: 熱速度1のMaxwell分布を自己無撞着に動かし、減衰率・周波数・符号付き場の履歴を独立した線形参照で調べます。
summary.en: Advance thermal Maxwellian full-f particles and compare damping rate, frequency and signed-field history with qualified independent linear references.

assumptions.ja: vth=ωp=λD=1、k=.5、L=4π、α=.01、格子32、256空間層×128速度節点、dt=.04、T16、固定窓[4,12]。シード33001–33004。 空間粒子層だけ512へ倍増する独立companionも固定します。
assumptions.en: vth=omega_p=lambda_D=1,k.5,L4pi,alpha.01,grid32,256spatial strata×128velocity nodes,dt.04,T16,fit[4,12],seeds33001–33004. A separately evolved512-spatial-strata companion changes only particle-space resolution.

caption.ja: 実際に動かした粒子の初期(x,v)に対する速度変化δv/α。空間2D流体図ではなく1D1V位相空間の応答です。
caption.en: Actual evolved particle velocity change delta-v/alpha against initial(x,v); a1D1V phase-space response, not a2D physical-space flow.

case_notes.ja: 固定窓[4,12]の平均減衰率−.154881、線形IVP同窓−.153648、分散根−.153359、平均周波数1.41272。空間粒子層256/512の率差は|gamma|の6.63e−5。512は同じPIC実装の基準振幅だけの感度検査で、独立非線形エンジンや振幅次数の証明ではありません。4シフトのSE/t区間は離散化バイアスを含めない条件付きの要約です。
case_notes.en: Fixed-window[4,12] mean gamma−.154881, same-window linear IVP−.153648, dielectric pole−.153359 and mean frequency1.41272.256/512strata rate gap is6.63e-5|gamma|.512is a same-engine sensitivity probe at the baseline amplitude only, not an independent nonlinear engine or an alpha-order proof. Four-shift SE/nominal t intervals exclude discretization bias.

title.ja: 温かいPICの二流初期成長
title.en: Warm PIC two-stream initial growth

summary.ja: 温度を持つ対向Maxwell二流を時間発展し、固定した線形窓の成長率と過渡を分散式・Volterra参照から分けて検査します。
summary.en: Evolve counter-streaming warm Maxwellians; distinguish fixed-window growth and transients using dielectric and Volterra references.

assumptions.en: Each stream thermal speed1,drifts±3,k.2,L10pi,alpha1e-5,grid32,64spatial strata×128total velocity nodes,dt.05,T40,fit[12,20],seeds34001–34004.

caption.ja: 実粒子のT40での速度変化δv/αを初期(x,v)に表示。1D1V位相空間の後期診断で、成長率を検証する固定窓[12,20]とは分けます。
caption.en: Actual particle delta-v/alpha atT40against initial(x,v). This1D1Vphase-space image is a late diagnostic; growth rates are validated only over[12,20].

case_notes.ja: 固定窓[12,20]の平均成長率.273111は同窓IVPの.273678と比較します。漸近分散根.284510に対する参照自身の過渡偏りは3.807%で、別判定として保持。T40の位相図は実際の後期応答の診断で、飽和精度の検証ではありません。
case_notes.en: Compare mean growth.273111 over[12,20] with the same-window IVP.273678. The reference itself has3.807%transient bias versus the asymptotic pole.284510, separately gated. The actualT40phase response is diagnostic, without a saturation-accuracy claim.

title.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合
title.en: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline

summary.ja: ベクトル化CIC/FFTと、別に書いた粒子ループCIC・密なDFTを、それぞれが自己無撞着な場を毎kick計算する軌道全体で照合します。
summary.en: Compare vectorized CIC/FFT with separately authored scalar-particle CIC/dense DFT; each trajectory sources its own field at every kick.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories.

algorithm.ja: 独立側はPythonスカラー配置、明示的な複素DFT和、独自の補間ループを所有します。主側のFFT・配置・補間を呼びません。数学上のCIC、Nyquist規約、velocity-Verlet法、初期配列は共通です。
algorithm.en: The independent path owns scalar deposition, explicit complex DFT sums and scalar gathering; it imports no primary spatial routines. Mathematical CIC, Nyquist convention, velocity-Verlet and initial arrays are intentionally shared.

validation.ja: 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。
validation.en: 19pytest and58/58fixed gates passed. Compare six pairs=twelve self-consistent trajectories at all13states; maximum differences:x8.88e-16,v3.33e-16,E8.33e-16,rho2.89e-15. Shared pytest+main.392s. Initial small pytest retained17/18with a periodic-index failure; integer wrapping was corrected before the first fixed main batch.

limits.ja: 離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limits.en: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit.

limits.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。
limits.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

name.ja: 代数的マルチグリッド（AMG）

summary.ja: 既存配布版：行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 固定した小規模な一定係数系列のみです。任意の係数ジャンプ、非構造格子、不定値系、最適計算量・一様収束を保証しません。異方性が常にκ₂を増やす、あるいは単調に収束を悪化させるとは主張しません。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

title.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける
title.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error

summary.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
summary.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の単位正方形、一定正係数の−Δu=f、全周同次Dirichlet境界、5点差分です。階層構築には座標・格子幅・nを渡さず、係数行列と暗黙の定数近似核だけを使います。入力は実対称正定値を前提とし、任意の不定値行列を扱うソルバーではありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unit square, constant-positive-coefficient −Δu=f, homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries and five-point differences. Hierarchy setup receives no coordinates, mesh width or n; it uses the coefficient matrix and an implicit constant near-null candidate. A real SPD input is assumed; arbitrary indefinite problems are outside scope.

algorithm.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
algorithm.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

validation.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
validation.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

limits.ja: 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。
limits.en: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error.

references.title: Algebraic multigrid by smoothed aggregation for second and fourth order elliptic problems

depth_scope.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。
depth_scope.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error.

title.ja: AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差
title.en: AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error

summary.ja: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。
summary.en: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error.

assumptions.ja: 正方格子から作るA=T⊗I+εI⊗T、n=7/15/31、ε=1/.1/.01です。これは既知解を持つ代数系の診断であり、連続PDEの精度検証は既存Poisson例に残します。同じnではκ₂はεによらず一定です。
assumptions.en: A=T⊗I+εI⊗T with n=7/15/31 and ε=1/.1/.01. This is a known-solution algebraic diagnostic; continuum PDE validation remains in the earlier Poisson example. At fixed square n, κ₂ is independent of ε.

algorithm.ja: MITライセンスの既存アトラス教材の平滑化集約AMGを新しい独立ソースへ再利用します。階層は行列だけから構築し、強度閾値.08、Jacobi平滑化、固定相対公差10⁻¹⁰、最大180 V-cycleを使います。DSTの正弦変換による直接反転は参照側だけです。
algorithm.en: Reuse the earlier MIT-licensed Atlas educational smoothed-aggregation AMG in a separate source release. Matrix-only hierarchy setup uses strength .08, Jacobi smoothing, fixed relative tolerance 10⁻¹⁰ and at most 180 V-cycles. Sine-transform spectral inversion is reference-side only.

validation.ja: 真の残差、独立直接解との差、DSTとの差、operator complexity、全残差履歴を保存します。最大固有値方向の右辺へ最小固有値方向の摂動を加え、相対増幅κ₂を直接解で照合します。等方例は収束必須、異方性stress例は予算終了も正直に記録する事前基準です。1-cycle対照は未収束を検出します。
validation.en: Store true residual, forward error, DST agreement, operator complexity and complete histories. Perturb a maximal-eigenmode RHS in the minimal-eigenmode direction and check the predicted relative amplification κ₂ with direct solves. Isotropic runs must converge; the predeclared anisotropy stress policy permits honestly reported budget exhaustion. A one-cycle control detects nonconvergence.

limits.ja: 固定した小規模な一定係数系列のみです。任意の係数ジャンプ、非構造格子、不定値系、最適計算量・一様収束を保証しません。異方性が常にκ₂を増やす、あるいは単調に収束を悪化させるとは主張しません。
limits.en: Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence.

name.ja: QR・SVD・最小二乗

summary.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。 QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
summary.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

limitations.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。 QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limitations.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

title.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
title.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

summary.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
summary.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

assumptions.ja: m≥nの小さな実行列が対象です。SVDの数値階数は最大特異値に対する相対しきい値10⁻¹²で定義し、零特異値方向を除くcompact因子を返します。QRは列ピボットなしで、階数判定には用いません。
assumptions.en: Small real matrices with m≥n. Numerical rank uses a 10⁻¹² threshold relative to the largest singular value; compact factors omit null directions. QR has no column pivoting and is not used as a rank-revealing method.

algorithm.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
algorithm.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

validation.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
validation.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

limits.ja: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。
limits.en: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results.

assumptions.ja: Hadamard直交因子U,Vとsⱼ=2⁻qj、q=0/4/8/12を使います。b=u₀とb+2⁻⁴⁰u_minを固定し、摂動増幅を測ります。q=0の重複特異値では個々の特異ベクトルは一意ではありません。
assumptions.en: Use Hadamard orthogonal factors U,V and sⱼ=2⁻qj for q=0/4/8/12. Fixed b=u₀ and b+2⁻⁴⁰u_min measure perturbation amplification. Individual singular vectors are nonunique for the repeated singular values at q=0.

algorithm.ja: Householder QR、片側Jacobi SVD、三角後退代入を実装します。SVDの数値階数閾値を10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴へ変え、同じ切捨て規約のLAPACK解と比較します。正規方程式の計算例は追加していません。
algorithm.en: Implement Householder QR, one-sided Jacobi SVD and triangular back substitution. Vary rank cutoffs 10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴ and compare with LAPACK solutions using the same truncation convention. No executed normal-equations comparison is added.

validation.ja: 再構成・直交性・特異値・右辺摂動による解差・最小二乗停留残差・厳密階数2の対照を保存します。高精度参照は実二進入力を整数比へ変換し、mpmath 1.3.0のSVDとQRを独立実行済みです。SHAと全4入力・両精度の完全性を実行時に検査し、不一致を解析解へ置換しません。
validation.en: Save reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, solution perturbations, least-squares stationarity and an exact rank-two control. The mpmath1.3.0 SVD and QR reference was actually executed using integer-ratio conversions of binary inputs. Runtime SHA and completeness guards check all four inputs at both precisions and never substitute analytic truth after a mismatch.

limits.ja: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limits.en: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

summary.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。 Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。 追加固定例：明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値、整合質量FEM弦の一般化固有値。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references. limitations.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。 Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度: NumPyの射影コアとSciPyの密参照はLAPACK基盤を共有し得るため、全面的に独立なバックエンドとはしません。解析固有値と独立構成対照を併用します。再始動、内部固有値、大規模疎行列、普遍的な単調収束は対象外です。 追加固定例：単一対称実固有対だけ。暗黙再始動・Krylov-Schur・ロッキング・一般の非正規やクラスターは未実装。 小規模1D弦のみ。SciPyが返す前の例外では入力を保存し、未返却の内部反復を保存したとはしません。 成分資格35判定は4科学例の合格を代用せず、元SciPy内部の未返却反復は保存済みとしません。
limitations.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals: Unrestarted small-matrix educational examples with separated extreme eigenpairs. Interior/clustered eigenvalues, very large sparse matrices, strong nonnormality, shift-invert and implicitly restarted Arnoldi are outside scope. A small eigenpair residual alone is not treated as a rigorous eigenvalue-error bound for nonnormal matrices. Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity: NumPy projected solves and SciPy dense references may share LAPACK infrastructure and are not claimed fully independent backends. Analytic eigenvalues and constructed controls provide additional checks. Restarting, interior eigenvalues, large sparse systems and universal monotonic convergence are outside scope. Additional fixed examples: One eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix only. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, or general nonnormal or clustered-spectrum capability is claimed. A small 1D string only. If SciPy raises before returning, inputs are retained; unreturned internal iterates are not claimed to be saved. The 35 component checks do not replace the four full scientific cases.

title.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
title.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

summary.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
summary.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

assumptions.ja: 対称問題では実対称行列、非対称問題では既知の分離した最大固有値5を持つ実行列を使います。初期ベクトルは固定seedです。非対称Ritz値は複素数を許し、最大実部で選びます。
assumptions.en: The symmetric case is real symmetric; the nonsymmetric case is real with a known separated largest eigenvalue 5. Starting vectors use fixed seeds. Nonsymmetric Ritz values may be complex and are selected by largest real part.

algorithm.ja: Lanczosの3項漸化式に2回の全再直交化を加え、Arnoldiは修正Gram–Schmidtを2回行います。小さな射影行列T/HだけをNumPyのeigh/eigで解き、元空間へRitzベクトルを戻します。大きな元行列の密固有値計算は参照側だけで使います。
algorithm.en: Lanczos uses its three-term recurrence plus two passes of full reorthogonalization; Arnoldi uses two-pass modified Gram–Schmidt. Only the small projected T/H is solved by NumPy eigh/eig before lifting Ritz vectors. A full dense solve of the original matrix is used only on the reference side.

validation.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
validation.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

limits.ja: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。
limits.en: Unrestarted small-matrix educational examples with separated extreme eigenpairs. Interior/clustered eigenvalues, very large sparse matrices, strong nonnormality, shift-invert and implicitly restarted Arnoldi are outside scope. A small eigenpair residual alone is not treated as a rigorous eigenvalue-error bound for nonnormal matrices.

title.ja: Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度
title.en: Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity

summary.ja: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。
summary.en: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace.

assumptions.ja: 対称行列の上位2固有値の間隔は1/.1/.01です。非正規行列は実浮動小数点の上三角行列でK=10/1000とし、対角が既知固有値です。浮動小数点の相似変換後に名目スペクトルを厳密真値とは呼びません。
assumptions.en: Top symmetric gaps are1/.1/.01. Nonnormal matrices are actual floating-point upper-triangular inputs with K=10/1000 and known diagonal eigenvalues. Nominal spectra after floating-point similarity construction are not labelled exact truth.

algorithm.ja: 全再直交化Lanczosと2回MGSのArnoldiで縮約し、小さい射影行列だけを密に解きます。上位2ベクトルはQRで張る空間へ変換し、符号や回転に不変な射影行列差を測ります。
algorithm.en: Use fully reorthogonalized Lanczos and two-pass MGS Arnoldi; only the small projected matrix is solved densely. Compare QR-spanned top-two subspace projectors, invariant under signs and cluster rotations.

validation.ja: 解析的対角固有値とSciPy密固有値、左右固有ベクトルによる条件数を照合します。別に構成した2×2擬固有対ではK=1000で残差約2.5×10⁻⁸に対し固有値誤差.005を示します。これは反復法が出力した失敗例ではなく、残差だけでは保証できないことを示す感度対照です。
validation.en: Compare analytic triangular eigenvalues, SciPy dense eigenvalues and left/right eigenvector condition numbers. A separately constructed2×2 pseudoeigenpair has residual about2.5×10⁻⁸ but eigenvalue error.005 at K=1000. It is a sensitivity control, not a failure produced by the iterative solver.

limits.ja: NumPyの射影コアとSciPyの密参照はLAPACK基盤を共有し得るため、全面的に独立なバックエンドとはしません。解析固有値と独立構成対照を併用します。再始動、内部固有値、大規模疎行列、普遍的な単調収束は対象外です。
limits.en: NumPy projected solves and SciPy dense references may share LAPACK infrastructure and are not claimed fully independent backends. Analytic eigenvalues and constructed controls provide additional checks. Restarting, interior eigenvalues, large sparse systems and universal monotonic convergence are outside scope.

assumptions.ja: 単位弦・張力密度1、同次Dirichlet、内部15/31/63点、最低3固有対。
assumptions.en: A unit string with unit tension and density and homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints. Use 15, 31 and 63 interior nodes and the lowest three eigenpairs.

algorithm.ja: 要素からK,Mを組み立て、M内積のK^-1M KrylovとSciPy LOBPCGを比較。小規模な厳密K逆前処理。 LOBPCG初期列は{1,x³,x⁶}。K逆Mの次数+2像を初期spanから独立にし、{1,x,x²}の構造的階数欠落を避ける。 同じMの作用を資格済einsumのLinearOperatorで与え、dense-B adapterを通さない。固有値solver自体はSciPy LOBPCG。
algorithm.en: Elementwise K and M assembly, M-inner-product Krylov iteration on K^-1 M, and actual SciPy LOBPCG with a small exact-K-inverse preconditioner. LOBPCG starts from {1, x^3, x^6}; degree-plus-two images avoid the structural rank defect of {1, x, x^2}. The same M is applied through a qualified einsum LinearOperator, avoiding the dense-B adapter. The eigensolver itself remains SciPy LOBPCG.

validation.ja: 一般化dense eigh、独立離散スペクトル、連続体(jπ)^2への細分化。M直交性と元残差は別量。
validation.en: Generalized dense eigh, an independent discrete spectrum and refinement toward (j*pi)^2. M-orthogonality and original residuals are distinct quantities.

name.ja: Gauss求積・適応積分

group.ja: 近似・変換・数値積分

summary.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。 固定した教育用実行例：領域別QUADPACKと有限Simpson対照、G7/K15と有限区間tanh-sinh、2〜4次元テンソル・Smolyak対照。
summary.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK. Fixed educational executions: QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions, G7/K15 and finite-interval tanh-sinh, Tensor and Smolyak controls in two to four dimensions.

limitations.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limitations.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

title.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
title.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

summary.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
summary.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 有限区間上の滑らかな実関数、無次元の積分です。固定Gauss次数2・4・8・16と、適応絶対公差10⁻⁵・10⁻⁷・10⁻⁹を別々に走査します。両端特異点・不連続・無限区間は今回の入力では扱いません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless smooth real functions on finite intervals. Fixed Gauss orders 2/4/8/16 and adaptive absolute tolerances 10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹ are swept separately. Endpoint singularities, discontinuities and infinite intervals are not covered by these inputs.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschで対称Jacobi行列の固有値を節点、最初の固有ベクトル成分の平方の2倍を重みとします。適応Simpsonは区間を二分し、|S左+S右−S全|/15を局所推定として公差を配分します。評価回数と深さの上限を持ち、未達を成功としません。
algorithm.en: Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly.

validation.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
validation.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

limits.ja: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。
limits.en: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK.

title.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
title.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

summary.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
summary.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 区間[0,1]、Gauss次数8/16/32/64/128、公差10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹です。Lorentz幅.1/.03/.01、相殺係数0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶を固定します。零積分の相対条件数は未定義としてnullで保存します。
assumptions.en: Use[0,1], Gauss orders8/16/32/64/128 and tolerances10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹. Lorentz widths are.1/.03/.01; cancellation scales are0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶. A zero integral has undefined relative condition, stored as null.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschの節点・重みと、局所差/15を用いる適応Simpsonを実装します。端点ではx=t²変換を別対照とし、狭いbumpには既知支持区間を分割した対照を用意します。これは一般的な自動救済機構ではありません。
algorithm.en: Implement Golub–Welsch nodes/weights and adaptive Simpson with a local difference/15 estimate. Companion checks use x=t² for the endpoint and a known-support split for the narrow bump; these are not general automatic rescue mechanisms.

validation.ja: roots_legendre、解析atan積分、2/3、bumpの256w/315、独立QUADPACKを比較します。QUADPACKの状態・推定誤差・評価回数・警告文も保存します。相殺はε_machine×積分絶対量に対応する絶対予算を使います。初期5点が全て零のbumpでは推定誤差0と実誤差約.00813を明示します。
validation.en: Compare roots_legendre, analytic atan integrals,2/3,the bump integral256w/315 and independent QUADPACK. Preserve QUADPACK status, estimated error, evaluation count and warning message. Cancellation uses a roundoff-aware absolute budget. When all initial five bump samples vanish, expose estimated error0 versus actual error about.00813.

limits.ja: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limits.en: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

summary.ja: Bratuの合成観測から係数を推定し、2パラメータの随伴勾配、正則化の偏り、観測感度の特異値と識別不能例を検証する。 追加固定例：GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較、既知最小点でのBFGSと3組L-BFGS、雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Fit Bratu coefficients from synthetic observations and verify two-parameter adjoint gradients, regularization bias, data-sensitivity singular values and nonidentifiable observations. Additional fixed examples: Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares, BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima, Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

references.scope: Author official manual; the detailed chapter records the selected SVD and standard-form Tikhonov/nonzero-prior passages consulted. The local Bratu implementation is independent of the MATLAB toolbox.

assumptions: Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data.
The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model.
Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank.
methods.units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales.
methods.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1].

next_deliverable.ja: データに基づく正則化強度の選択、多数係数、実測データ、より一般的な最適化法の独立検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separate validation for data-driven regularization selection, many coefficients, real data and more general optimization methods.

limitations.ja: 小規模な滑らかなBratu下側分枝と固定合成観測による教育用検証。2パラメータ空間係数の推定、Tikhonov正則化、局所的なデータ感度のSVD、中央観測の階数不足と反射対称性による曖昧さを扱う。正則化による事前値の選択を観測情報の増加と解釈しない。実測データ、多数係数の関数推定、大域的一意性、統計的信頼区間、準Newton法全般は検証しない。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
limitations.en: Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method. No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread. Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed inputs, independently reviewed references and criteria, actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP. See release-specific scope and retained failure history.

title.ja: GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較

summary.ja: 同じ観測からの17固定fitで、変数尺度・重み・境界と物理座標の停止条件を分けます。
summary.en: Seventeen fixed fits separate parameter scaling, weights, bounds and physical-coordinate stopping conditions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D Bratu、31内点、u(0)=u(1)=0。既存の2係数モデルと保存済み観測を再利用。正則化γとLM減衰μを別に扱います。
assumptions.en: A dimensionless one-dimensional Bratu problem with 31 interior nodes and zero Dirichlet data. The existing two-coefficient extension and saved observations are reused; objective regularization gamma and LM damping mu are distinct.

algorithm.ja: 独自SVD最小二乗GN/LM、元の投影勾配、SciPy TRF、非有界SciPy LM。lower/upperベクトルを元PGの係数別区間へ明示変換。
algorithm.en: Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals.

validation.ja: 独立Thomas状態・感度と4局所参照fit。最終状態残差、物理勾配または投影勾配、目的値差、データのみのSVD、活性境界を検査。非有界法の共通参照は内点かつ非有界停留が条件です。
validation.en: Independent Thomas states/sensitivities and four local reference fits. Gate final state residuals, physical gradient or projected gradient, objective gaps, data-only SVD and active bounds. Common references for unbounded methods must be strictly interior and unbounded-stationary.

limits.ja: 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
limits.en: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.

title.ja: 既知最小点でのBFGSと3組L-BFGS
title.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

summary.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と3初期値のRosenbrockを用い、曲率・strong Wolfe・現在の有限記憶作用を検査します。
summary.en: An eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts test curvature, strong Wolfe conditions and the current finite-memory action.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

algorithm.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
algorithm.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

validation.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
validation.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

limits.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
limits.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

title.ja: 雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化
title.en: Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths

summary.ja: 2独立ノイズベクトルを尺度・データ文脈で共有し、42固定fitから有限γ選択と固定γの局所共分散を分けます。
summary.en: Two independent noise vectors are reused across scales and data contexts. Forty-two fixed fits separate finite-list gamma selection from fixed-gamma local covariance.

assumptions.ja: Bratu推定は31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存1023格子のデータは保存値を使い再生成しません。σ=1e-4/1e-3、seed67001/67002、γの固定5点です。
assumptions.en: Bratu inference uses 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Existing 1023-grid observations are reused without regeneration. Fixed sigma values are 1e-4/1e-3, seeds are 67001/67002 and the gamma list has five entries.

algorithm.ja: 全γのfitを資格した完全経路だけから、実現雑音ノルムの1.05倍を満たす最大γを選択。不完全経路と完全だが候補なしを分離。4点L-curveは記述診断。
algorithm.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

validation.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。
validation.en: Gate final residuals, physical KKT conditions and completion for all 42 fits, the selection rule, and covariance/bias/model-shift response against explicit scalar 2x2 algebra, including symmetry and PSD.

limits.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
limits.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

summary.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。 MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件: 同一鎖の62datasetを別環境ArviZ0.20.0で実計算し、固定recipe・入力・鎖・公式ソースSHAで結びます。通常の有限値照合と、不定値のpolicy差を分けて検査します。 追加固定例：相関2変量Gaussianのjoint標的とMCSE。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration. Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies: Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences. Additional fixed examples: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

limitations.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 定数observableのESS=NというArviZ raw規約を混合の証拠にしません。全同値はnull＋status、鎖ごとに異なる定数のRhatはnull＋infinite-separationとして、ライブラリの巨大finite/infを残し通常有限値の一致点から除外します。bulk ESSは原スケール平均のMCSEへ流用しません。 今回の追加固定例：診断engineの独立性とsamplerの独立参照を混同しません。Rhat等は大域収束・被覆の証明ではありません。isotropicは固定比較で失敗を要求せず、banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSは未実装です。
limitations.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator. Additional fixed examples: Diagnostic-engine independence is not an independent sampler. Rhat/ESS/MCSE do not prove global convergence/coverage. Isotropic is descriptive with no required failure;banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSremain unimplemented.

title.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS

summary.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
summary.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。
assumptions.en: One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps.

algorithm.ja: log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。
algorithm.en: Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat.

validation.ja: 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。
validation.en: Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs.

limits.ja: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。
limits.en: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained.

limits.ja: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。
limits.en: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations.

title.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案
title.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal

summary.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
summary.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.

algorithm.ja: 局所幅.8、mixedのみ確率.1でy=−x+.8Z、それ以外y=x+.8Z。混合率は状態非依存でq(y|x)=q(x|y)のため対数標的比でMH判定。各鎖は独立PCG64 stream、提案の適応・棄却の間引きなし。
algorithm.en: Local scale.8; mixed uses y=−x+.8Z with probability.1, otherwise y=x+.8Z. The state-independent mixture is symmetric q(y|x)=q(x|y), so MH uses the log-target ratio. Chains use independent PCG64 streams, with no adaptation or removal of rejected states.

validation.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
validation.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

measured.scope: Scenario pass means expected behavior was detected; controls do not claim sampler convergence. Prefixes are nested, not independent repetitions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained.

limits.ja: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 定数observableのESS=NというArviZ raw規約を混合の証拠にしません。全同値はnull＋status、鎖ごとに異なる定数のRhatはnull＋infinite-separationとして、ライブラリの巨大finite/infを残し通常有限値の一致点から除外します。bulk ESSは原スケール平均のMCSEへ流用しません。
limits.en: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator.

title.ja: MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件
title.en: Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies

summary.ja: 同一鎖の62datasetを別環境ArviZ0.20.0で実計算し、固定recipe・入力・鎖・公式ソースSHAで結びます。通常の有限値照合と、不定値のpolicy差を分けて検査します。
summary.en: Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences.

algorithm.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
algorithm.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

validation.ja: 実鎖9組×3prefix×x/indicator＋8小fixtureの62組。同じbytesを再生成して照合し、通常の有限値Rhat/ESS/ACFと、定数・鎖内ゼロ分散・odd・ties・shift・scaleを検査。別の直接lag和、定常AR(1)の無限列tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho)で有限推定の誤差も測定します。routineは保存参照との照合で、ArviZのその場再実行は任意の別手順です。
validation.en: 62 datasets: nine actual chains times three prefixes times x/indicator plus eight small fixtures. Regenerate and hash identical bytes; compare ordinary finite Rhat/ESS/ACF and test constants, zero within-chain variance, odd lengths, ties, shift and scale. Direct lag sums and infinite-series stationary-AR(1) tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho) provide separate checks of finite estimates. Routine runs compare stored references; live ArviZ regeneration is a separate optional procedure.

title.ja: 相関2変量Gaussianのjoint標的とMCSE
title.en: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian

summary.ja: 実2D MH軌道を既知のjointモーメントと同一データArviZ診断で検査。
summary.en: Test actual2D MH paths against known joint moments and same-data ArviZ diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 平均(1,-1)、相関.95・対角分散1。4独立chainset×4chain、burn1024/draw8192、prefix2048/8192。固定.9Lzと.25z、適応なし。
assumptions.en: Mean(1,-1),unit marginal variances,rho.95;4independent chainsets×4chains;burn1024/draw8192;prefix2048/8192. Fixed.9Lzand.25z,no adaptation.

algorithm.ja: 対称random-walk MH、拒否状態も保持。8観測量それぞれのoriginal-scale meanESS/MCSEを計算し、rankbulkESSを流用しません。
algorithm.en: Symmetric random-walk MH retains rejected states. Compute original-scale meanESS/MCSE separately for8observables;rank bulkESS is not substituted.

validation.ja: 4つのpreconditioned最終prefix全観測量にRhat/ESS/MCSE/既知moment条件。同じ128scalararrayを別ArviZ0.20過程へ渡した640値資格と全データSHAで照合。標的は解析Gaussianモーメントで別検査。 640比較は不変な同一データfixture上で行い、別に生成する8組のfresh軌道で物理・混合判定を行います。環境を跨ぐ生成配列のbit一致は要求しません。
validation.en: Gate all full-prefix observables in4preconditioned chainsets by Rhat/ESS/MCSE/knownmoments. Match exact dataSHAand640values from128scalar arrays in a separateArviZ0.20process. Target law is separately checked by analytic Gaussian moments. All640comparisons use the immutable same-data fixture;8freshchainsets independently receive the unchanged physical/mixing gates. No portable generated-byte-identity claim.

limits.ja: 診断engineの独立性とsamplerの独立参照を混同しません。Rhat等は大域収束・被覆の証明ではありません。isotropicは固定比較で失敗を要求せず、banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSは未実装です。
limits.en: Diagnostic-engine independence is not an independent sampler. Rhat/ESS/MCSE do not prove global convergence/coverage. Isotropic is descriptive with no required failure;banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSremain unimplemented.

title.ja: GBMのweak誤差とMonte Carlo標準誤差
title.en: GBM weak bias and Monte Carlo error

summary.ja: 連続真値、離散EM期待値、同一経路差とMCSEを分離する固定入力です。
summary.en: Separate continuous truth,exact discrete EM expectation,paired-path weak difference and MCSE.

assumptions.ja: dX=.5Xdt+.4XdW,X0=1。無次元T=1、8/16/32/64刻み、独立32seed×1024経路。状態軸に境界・clipなし。
assumptions.en: dX=.5Xdt+.4XdW,X0=1;dimensionlessT1;8/16/32/64steps;32independent seeds×1024paths. Unbounded state,no clipping.

algorithm.ja: fine Gaussian増分を固定block和で集約し、厳密端点1配列を全刻みで共有。OUの厳密積分はdWとの共分散を保つ独立bridge正規変数から構成。異なる加算順の和のbit一致は主張しません。
algorithm.en: Aggregate fixed fine Gaussian blocks;reuse one exact terminal array. OUexact kicks use the correct jointly sampled integral with independent bridge noise. Different floating reduction orders need not be bit identical.

validation.ja: 軌道前にDecimal80/120・独立GH/OU共分散積分とpaired分散による標本解像を資格。各モーメントの5MCSE校正、MCSE精度、固定3段weak率、最後2段の3SE解像を判定。区間の被覆は離散真値に対する有限32反復の記述値。
validation.en: Before paths qualify Decimal80/120,independent GH/OUcovariance integrals and paired-variance allocation. Gate5MCSE calibration,MCSE precision,fixed three-level weak rate and final-two-level3SE resolution. Coverage is descriptive over32batches against discrete truth.

limits.ja: 弱誤差は期待値の差です。3SEや区間を真の誤差上界・一般被覆保証としません。1D状態×時間の保存例であり2D物理流れではありません。GBMやOU浴成分を新しい物理問題として重複計数しません。
limits.en: Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused.
