limitations.ja: 感度配布版は滑らかなBratu下側分枝と非対称の小規模線形例による教育用検証。離散随伴の内積と目的関数の積分重みを明記する。定数λの推定と2パラメータ空間係数の正則化・識別可能性は別の逆問題配布版で扱う。時間依存随伴と衝撃波感度は未実装。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limitations.en: The sensitivity edition verifies smooth lower-branch Bratu and a small nonsymmetric linear example with explicit adjoint pairing and objective quadrature. Separate inverse editions fit constant lambda and two spatial coefficients with regularization and identifiability checks. Time-dependent adjoints and shock sensitivities remain unimplemented. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

assumptions_ja: 滑らかな残差とスカラー目的関数を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。

title.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint
title.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay

summary.ja: 後退Eulerの離散写像を実際に逆伝播し、接線・独立高精度mode解・block replayと比較します。
summary.en: Reverse the actual backward-Euler map and compare tangent derivatives, independent high-precision modes and block replay.

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、u(0,t)=u(1,t)=0。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256、T=.1。κ=.1、θ=.2。目的関数のh重みを含む座標転置です。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1], fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints, 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps to T=.1; kappa=.1 and theta=.2. Coordinate transposes include explicit objective h weights.

algorithm.ja: ThomasでB u次=u現在+dt θbを解き、Bの転置を逆順に解きます。16stepごとにcheckpointを保存し、1blockを同じ順で再計算します。full配列を保存・解放した後で別の所有期間を測ります。
algorithm.en: Thomas solves B u_next=u_current+dt theta b; reverse solves use B transpose. Save checkpoints every16steps and replay one block in the original order. Serialize and release the full trajectory before the separate checkpoint ownership window.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification.

limits.ja: 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
limits.en: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

title.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度
title.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

summary.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
summary.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

assumptions.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
assumptions.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. title.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
title.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

summary.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
summary.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

assumptions.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
assumptions.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

algorithm.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

limits.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

scope.ja: 追加固定例：時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint、離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。

summary.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送: 純吸収の定常輻射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。 追加固定例：等方散乱平板の反射・透過・吸収。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Su–Olson1996非平衡拡散、Su–Olson1997角度輸送の独立公開表比較。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：2D吸収影と保存的M1輸送、2D反向beamとM1閉包の情報損失。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage. Additional fixed examples: Isotropic scattering in a finite slab. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Su–Olson1996 non-equilibrium diffusion, Su–Olson transport with an independently published analytical table. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport, Opposing beams and information loss in the M1 closure. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

limitations.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送: 多重散乱、熱輻射、周波数再分配、動的媒質、輻射流体連成は未実装です。StamnesらのDISORTの全機能・安定化を再現したとは表示しません。 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計: 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱輻射・輻射流体連成は未検証です。 今回の追加固定例：有限の4平板に限定。MC、一般角度phase関数、DISORT再現、普遍的次数や厳密連続体誤差境界は認証しません。 今回の追加固定例：1996拡散であり1997角度輸送とは別です。原典本文は未読、公式ソフトの選択値を資格。物理単位の質量opacity解釈は使わず無次元関数を直接参照します。 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。 今回の追加固定例：6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
limitations.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated. Additional fixed examples: Limited to fourfixedisotropic slabs;noMC,generalphase-function/DISORT reproduction,universalorder or rigorouscontinuumerrorbound. Additional fixed examples: This1996diffusion model is distinct from1997angular transport. Original paper fulltext unread;officialsoftware selected values qualified. Direct dimensionless functions avoid ambiguous mass-opacity physical-wrapper units. No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented. Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. title.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送
title.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab

summary.ja: 純吸収の定常輻射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。
summary.en: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux.

assumptions.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の一様平板。正の半球から単位強度が入射し、逆向きの入射・散乱・内部輻射はゼロです。
assumptions.en: A uniform slab of optical depth 0.7 receives unit intensity over the positive hemisphere, with zero reverse inflow, scattering and emission.

algorithm.ja: 正のGauss–Legendre離散方向と1次風上有限体積の空間行進を使います。角度誤差だけを分ける系列では、一定セル内を指数関数で正確に伝播します。
algorithm.en: Use positive Gauss–Legendre ordinates and first-order upstream finite-volume marching. A separate angular-error sweep uses exact exponential propagation within each constant cell.

validation.ja: 32〜512セルで全方向の強度誤差・空間フラックス誤差・正値性・離散吸収収支を確認。4〜32方向の別系列は、出射フラックス2pi E3(tau)の解析表示と比較します。
validation.en: With 32–512 cells, check all ray intensities, spatial flux error, positivity and discrete absorption balance. A separate 4–32-ordinate sweep compares exit flux with the analytic 2pi E3(tau) representation.

limits.ja: 多重散乱、熱輻射、周波数再分配、動的媒質、輻射流体連成は未実装です。StamnesらのDISORTの全機能・安定化を再現したとは表示しません。
limits.en: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization.

title.ja: 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計
title.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

summary.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
summary.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

assumptions.ja: 定常一様平板、光学的厚さ.1/.7/3、正の半球から単位強度、逆入射・散乱・内部輻射0。フラックス基準の光子入射方向はpdf=2muです。
assumptions.en: Steady uniform slab, optical depths .1/.7/3, unit incoming positive-hemisphere intensity, no reverse inflow/scattering/emission. Incoming photon directions for a flux estimator have density 2mu.

algorithm.ja: 1次風上有限体積の空間更新とGauss–Legendre方向を使い、角度系列は正確な指数伝播で空間誤差を除きます。MCはmu=sqrt(U)と指数光学距離から生存・吸収を独立に判定します。
algorithm.en: Use upstream finite volumes and Gauss-Legendre ordinates; exact exponential propagation removes spatial error in the angle series. Monte Carlo independently tracks survival/absorption using mu=sqrt(U) and exponential optical paths.

validation.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
validation.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.

limits.ja: 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱輻射・輻射流体連成は未検証です。
limits.en: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated.

validation.en: Fiveprimaryrunsseparatespace,32/64angles,timeandindependentW/Verrors. Finite/causalzero/homogeneousanalyticsource normalization oftheprovidedtableswerequalifiedbeforemain. limits.ja: 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。

title.ja: 2D吸収影と保存的M1輸送
title.en: Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport

summary.ja: 実際の円形吸収体の影を、特性線の円弦減衰・角度輸送・M1で比較します。
summary.en: Compare the actual evolved circular-absorber shadow with characteristic chord attenuation, signed-angle transport and nonlinear M1.

assumptions.ja: 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。
assumptions.en: Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets.

algorithm.ja: 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
algorithm.en: Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

validation.ja: 独立な特性cell平均と閉M1強制項の複素step検査191項目がmain前に合格。全step収支・cone・正値、別時間probe、MMSとx/y実進行の収束を検査します。 新fluxの762固定成分判定がPDE改訂前に合格。旧17pytestを維持し方向別fluxの5回帰を追加した22pytestと、元24計算・166科学判定を同じ120秒上限で再検査します。
validation.en: The independent characteristic cell averages and manufactured M1 forcing passed191reference/component checks before any PDE main. Check all-step budgets, realizability and positivity, spatial refinement, a separate half-step probe, and actual x/y evolution. Opposing-beam closure error is distinguished from numerical error. The new general flux passed762fixed component checks before this revised PDE main. Retain the17old tests and add5directional regressions=22tests; all24fixed runs and166scientific gates remain unchanged under the same120second limit.

limits.ja: 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
limits.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.

title.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布
title.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component

summary.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子のランダム二体衝突で、保存則と平衡分布への緩和を検証します。
summary.en: Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules.

assumptions.ja: 等質・等質量・等方散乱・一定衝突率。各roundで全粒子を一度ずつランダムに組み合わせます。初期は±sqrt(3)の二つのビームで、温度の目標は1です。 各seedは総運動量0・総エネルギー固定のmicrocanonical系で、Maxwell/Gammaは大粒子数極限の参照です。
assumptions.en: Homogeneous, equal masses, isotropic scattering and constant collision rate. Each round randomly matches every particle once. Two initial beams at ±sqrt(3) give target temperature one. Each seed has zero total momentum and fixed total energy: its finite-N equilibrium is microcanonical, while Maxwell/Gamma are large-N references.

algorithm.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
algorithm.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

validation.ja: 粒子512・2048・8192、16 seedで、運動量・運動エネルギー、Maxwellの2次/4次モーメント、Gamma(3/2,1)のエネルギーCDFを比較。異方性の期待減衰率(N−2)/(2(N−1))も独立に照合します。 有限Nの成分4次モーメントは3−6/(3N−1)であり、Maxwell値3との有限N偏りとseed間の標本誤差を区別します。
validation.en: Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty.

limits.ja: DSMCの衝突部分の教育例です。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存の衝突選択、実際の輸送係数・流れ場・全seedでの保証は含みません。Bird原著の剛体球条件を再現したとは主張しません。
limits.en: This is an educational DSMC collision component. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection, measured transport coefficients/flow fields or every-seed guarantee. Bird’s original hard-sphere conditions are not reproduced.

depth_scope.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布: 等質なMaxwell分子のランダム二体衝突で、保存則と平衡分布への緩和を検証します。 DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
depth_scope.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component: Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules. DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

title.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差
title.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error

summary.ja: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
summary.en: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

assumptions.ja: 等質・等質量・等方散乱のMaxwell分子、N=16/64/256、独立64seed、運動量0、sum|v|²=3N。二つのビームから24round衝突させ、roundは物理時間へ換算しません。
assumptions.en: Homogeneous equal-mass isotropic Maxwell collisions; N=16/64/256, 64 independent seeds, zero momentum and sum|v|²=3N. Start with two beams and run 24 collision rounds; rounds are not calibrated physical time.

algorithm.ja: ランダムな完全対合と球面一様の散乱で、各対の運動量・エネルギーを保持します。別の標本生成ではGaussianを重心ゼロ部分空間へ射影し、半径を固定します。
algorithm.en: Uniform random complete matchings and isotropic pair scattering preserve pair momentum/energy. An independent sampler projects Gaussian vectors into the zero-center-of-mass subspace and fixes their radius.

validation.ja: 全roundの運動量・エネルギーの最大保存誤差は決定論的な許容値で検査します。最初の6roundの異方性、4点のエネルギーCDF、4次モーメントと有限NのBeta参照との差は、独立seed間の標準誤差で測ります。NによるCDF標準誤差の減少と、有限NからMaxwellへの偏りを分けます。
validation.en: Check maximum momentum/energy errors over all rounds against deterministic tolerances. Use independent-seed standard errors for six-round anisotropy, four energy-CDF points and fourth moments against the finite-N beta reference. Separate decreasing CDF sampling error with N from finite-N Maxwell bias.

limits.ja: 固定した64seedの統計的診断であり、全seedの保証ではありません。同一seed内の粒子は保存量で相関し、IIDのKS p値へ読み替えません。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存衝突選択・輸送係数は含みません。
limits.en: Statistical diagnostics cover fixed 64-seed ensembles, not every seed. Conservation correlates particles within a seed; do not use IID KS p-values. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection or transport coefficients.

assumptions.ja: 1次元位置・3次元速度、H=2、Kn0=.5、完全拡散壁。壁温1、壁速度±.5。16セル、N=1024、dt=.02、burn20/sample40、4seed。

Reference36runs/87qualifiers already passed; primary results remain pending until the frozen run.

title.ja: 硬球DSMCのMach2平面衝撃波
title.en: Hard-sphere DSMC Mach2 planar shock

summary.ja: 物理時間の硬球衝突と実際の分子輸送を計算し、独立SPARTAの資格確認済みモーメント場と比較します。
summary.en: Evolve physical-time hard-sphere collisions and molecular streaming; compare actual moments with qualified independent SPARTA fields.

assumptions.ja: 1次元位置・3次元速度、単原子硬球。Mach2、区間[0,16]、RHの開境界reservoir。192セル、粒子重み1/192、dt=.01、burn20/sample20、12seed。
assumptions.en: {"kind":"shock","cells":192,"length":16,"weight":0.005208333333333333,"dt":0.01,"burn_in":20,"sample_time":20,"blocks":5,"bins":64,"sample_every":10,"hist_velocity":[-4,7]} Twelve independent seeds; primary fixed-weight mesh,particle-weight,and half-step companions each retain seed1.

algorithm.ja: セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。 2026-11-24版は固定reservoir係数、同一vで既評価の逆CDF残差、keep→left→right順の連結の再利用と、範囲確認した整数sort keyだけの可逆uint8圧縮を行う性能修正版です。元の乱数呼出順・安定sortの同値粒子順位・衝突対・科学設定を保ち、前3点の成分資格163項目に加え、sort keyを含む別348項目でbit/RNG一致を確認しました。いずれも成分検査であり、新mainと全保存科学値の一致はまだ未判定です。
algorithm.en: Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories. Edition2026-11-24 only reuses immutable reservoir coefficients and an inverse-CDF residual at unchanged v,fuses concatenation in unchanged keep-left-right order,and reversibly narrows range-checked integer sort keys to uint8 before the same stable sort. Original permutation/RNG calls,equal-key particle order,collision pairs and scientific inputs remain unchanged. The first three changes passed163component checks; a separate348check study qualifies the sort-key composition with exact byte/RNG comparisons. Neither is a new main run; full saved-science equality remains pending.

validation.ja: 各群20pytestを事前固定。新しい固定計算は15本。境界込みの質量・運動量・エネルギー、局所λ/衝突時間、独立参照への誤差とseed精度、時間block定常性を別に判定します。 群の判定は既存81項目を保持し、新8計算の48項目を追加した129項目です。primary t95はdf11、独立参照4seedはdf3です。 Nov23保存成功と全15計算・129判定の厳密比較を行う新mainは、本契約の時点で未実行です。20pytestと全mainの外部共有上限120秒、全診断・NPZ・CSVを維持します。
validation.en: Predeclare20pytest per group and15new fixed primary runs. Separate boundary-inclusive budgets,local lambda/collision-time diagnostics,reference error,whole-seed precision and block stationarity. Reference36runs/87qualifiers already passed; primary results remain pending until the frozen run. Preserve all81old gates and add48new-run gates=129. Primary12seed t95 usesdf11,reference4seed usesdf3; descriptive approximate-normal whole-seed intervals,not unconditional adaptive-study coverage. This new edition main has not run at contract freeze. Retain all20pytest,15runs,129gates and the original shared120s outer deadline,then compare every saved scientific array/history/metric with the immutable successful Nov23baseline. No independent reference is regenerated.

method_note.ja: セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。
method_note.en: Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories.

summary.ja: 小規模な固定例で、index-1 DAEの後退Euler・Newton法、整合初期化、保存則と拘束ドリフトを比較します。 追加固定例：index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値、振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Small fixed examples compare backward Euler and Newton for index-one DAEs, consistent initialization, conservation and constraint drift. Additional fixed examples: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE, Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values, Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

assumptions: For the index-one examples, the algebraic constraint Jacobian must be nonsingular on the selected branch and Newton iterations must satisfy fixed criteria.
Backward-Euler residuals use explicit differential and algebraic row scales. Consistent initialization and rejection of inconsistent input are checked separately.
The position-constrained pendulum is index three. Its examples use an underlying ODE and constraint-error stabilization, not a general high-index DAE solver.
Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinct from newly executed Radau/BDF/DOP853 references. The IDA executable is not newly run.
methods.units: Examples are nondimensional. Differential and algebraic residual rows use explicitly declared scales; their unscaled norms need not have the same units.
methods.boundary_conditions: There is no spatial boundary. Algebraic constraints and consistent initial state/derivative data are part of the initial-value formulation.

next_deliverable.ja: 別のモデルや大規模化は、入力・参照・基準を改めて固定して検証します。
next_deliverable.en: Other models and larger systems require separately frozen inputs, references and criteria.

limitations.ja: 固定した小規模系と入力に限ります。Robertsonの粗い刻みは当初の時間精度・収束目標を達成しておらず、元のFALSE判定を保存して表示します。微分した拘束を使うODEでは元の拘束がドリフトし得ます。一般のindex処理・大規模疎DAE・任意入力の収束は未検証です。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：単一の製造正枝・固定BE計算です。IDA実行や一般DAEソルバーの検証ではありません。 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。
limitations.en: Scope is limited to small fixed systems and inputs. The coarse Robertson schedule does not meet the original temporal accuracy/refinement goals; those false decisions are retained and shown. Underlying ODEs based on differentiated constraints can drift from the original constraint. General index handling, large sparse DAEs and convergence for arbitrary inputs are unverified. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification. Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule. No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

metadata_review.level: Small fixed-input educational implementation; canonical source and independently extracted ZIP verification are required before promotion. Original unmet accuracy goals remain explicit; source review is limited to the selected official sections and stored-output evidence.

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed inputs, independently reviewed references and criteria, actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP. See release-specific scope and retained failure history.

位置拘束の振り子はindex-3系です。追加例は微分拘束に基づくODEと拘束誤差の安定化を扱い、汎用高index DAEソルバーではありません。

method_note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
method_note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

limitations.en: Limited to educational real forward mode and small dense-Newton Bratu comparisons. Reverse mode, HVPs and matrix-free Newton–Krylov remain explanatory only. A separate dedicated supplement verifies implicit sensitivities and discrete adjoints. Additional fixed examples: An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Not a general NumPy/JAX replacement or complex AD system. No general reduced inverse Hessian or identification of finite Newton traces with implicit derivatives. An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.

title.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov
title.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products

summary.ja: 非線形Jacobianを組み立てずにBratuの上下枝を3種類のJvで解き、forcingと実際の残差・評価回数を保存します。
summary.en: Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.

assumptions.ja: 同じ無次元1次元Dirichlet問題でλ=3、内点63/127、初期値0または4sin(πx)。3Jv×2格子×2枝の12解法と固定η=1e-8の解析Jv対照1本。GMRES restart24/max96、Newton最大24、残差許容1e-9です。
assumptions.en: The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
algorithm.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの129固定判定が合格。非零Jvの解析検算、離散残差、独立解析上下枝、3modeの一致、forcing、評価回数、Krylov記憶幅、Armijoと固定η対照を確認。解析forcing検算は別計数で、FD/ADの反復制御には使いません。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared27 pytest tests and this case’s129 fixed gates: nonzero analytic Jv qualification, discrete residuals, independent analytic branches, mode agreement, forcing, evaluation ledgers, Krylov storage, Armijo and the constant-eta control. Analytic forcing validation is counted separately and does not steer FD/AD iterations.

limits.ja: 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
limits.en: An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

validation.en: Independently qualify all 49 residual-Jacobian columns, loss-gradient coordinates and spatial derivatives. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

limitations.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関: 調和ポテンシャル・固定seedの分布検証です。位置分散が正確でも運動量には有限刻み偏りがあります。他のサーモスタット、一般分子系、長時間の第一原理MDへ検証を移しません。 CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較: 特定の分離可能な四次2自由度・固定seedだけの小さな例です。Hを調和系のGamma分布と扱いません。全系相関には独立な厳密動力学参照がなく、相関一致や統計誤差に隠れる時間次数を合格主張しません。成熟分子系・輸送係数・量子・第一原理MDの検証ではありません。
limitations.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: A small example for one separable two-mode quartic potential and fixed seeds. H is not treated as harmonic Gamma. No independent exact full-system dynamical reference is claimed, and neither matching correlations nor time order hidden by sampling noise is an acceptance claim. Molecular transport, quantum and ab initio MD are outside scope.

summary.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。

title.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
title.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

summary.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
summary.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 両方式とも厳密な浴O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2)（OBABO）。CSVRは全運動量に同じ係数、Langevinは各成分に独立OU雑音を作用。γ=1/(2τ)で自由浴のK緩和時間をそろえます。以前のBAOAB例は変更せず別の分割として残します。
algorithm.en: Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting.

validation.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
validation.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

limits.ja: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。
limits.en: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), lambda=0.2, U=sum(omega²q²/2+lambda q⁴/4). Use 8192 canonical and 4096 heated replicas, t=20, tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05, lags 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 同じOBABO分割でglobal CSVRとlocal OUを比較。正準初期座標はGaussianを包絡にした独立棄却法、運動量はMaxwell分布から生成し、別の温度摂動初期集団も進めます。
algorithm.en: Compare global CSVR and local OU with the same OBABO splitting. Draw initial canonical positions by independent Gaussian-envelope rejection and momenta from Maxwell distributions, and evolve a separate heated initial ensemble.

validation.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
validation.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

title.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴
title.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling

summary.ja: 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。
summary.en: Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
assumptions.en: Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

algorithm.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
algorithm.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

validation.ja: 解析勾配、4096/8192段の固定RK4感度、拡張エネルギーとOU条件付き分散を照合します。
validation.en: Check energy gradients, fixed4096/8192 RK4 sensitivity, extended energy, OU heat bookkeeping and conditional temperature variance.

limits.ja: 短い自作教育模型です。第一原理・長いNVE・一般CPMD・正準平衡・エルゴード性の成功は主張しません。
limits.en: Long first-principles NVE and general electronic/nuclear thermostat equilibration remain deferred. No material prediction, multi-orbital CPMD or canonical/ergodic sampling certificate.

assumptions.ja: 質量1/2/3の1D3粒子と1つの共通調和ポテンシャル。拘束なし・COM・COM＋相対・冗長行を含む同じ拘束でf=3/2/1/1、各1,024レプリカを用います。
assumptions.en: Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas.

algorithm.ja: 質量重み付き接空間でLangevin/CSVRをOBABO分割します。初期正準共分散からの有限時刻写像・雑音共分散を直接組み、連続参照と離散定常Lyapunov解を別に求めます。
algorithm.en: Apply tangent-space Langevin/CSVR in OBABO form. Build finite-time maps and noise covariance from canonical initial data; compute continuous references and stationary discrete Lyapunov solutions separately.

validation.ja: Fractionによる独立なrank/共分散、符号付きf1浴、正しい投影OU恒等式と誤ったambient自由度の負例を照合。220分布族、符号付き2時刻積、正しい/誤った温度分母を保存します。
validation.en: Check independent Fraction rank/covariance,signedf1 baths,the valid projectedOU identity and a wrong-ambientDOF counterexample. Retain220CDF families,signed two-time products and correct/incorrect temperature denominators.

limits.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
limits.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

summary.ja: CSVRの厳密浴：条件付き分布・揺らぎ・運動エネルギー相関: 自由度1・2・6のCSVR浴だけを実装し、厳密な条件付きモーメントと非心χ²分布、正準Gamma分布と運動エネルギー相関を照合します。 CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
summary.en: Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation: Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

caution.ja: 分布の正しさと実時間の運動の再現を別々に調べる。結合時間・積分刻み・自由度数を明記する。
caution.en: Assess equilibrium distributions separately from real-time dynamics. State the coupling time, integration step and degree-of-freedom count.

limitations.ja: CSVRの厳密浴：条件付き分布・揺らぎ・運動エネルギー相関: 浴の診断用ケースで独立した物理問題数へ加算しません。浴がKを正しく分布させてもglobal rescalingだけでは方向を熱化しません。exp(−t/τ)を力付きMDのK相関へ流用しません。固定seedと予算に対する統計判定で、一般の混合保証ではありません。 CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較: 特定の分離可能な四次2自由度・固定seedだけの小さな例です。Hを調和系のGamma分布と扱いません。全系相関には独立な厳密動力学参照がなく、相関一致や統計誤差に隠れる時間次数を合格主張しません。成熟分子系・輸送係数・量子・第一原理MDの検証ではありません。
limitations.en: Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation: A bath diagnostic, not another independent physical problem. Correct K sampling does not thermalize momentum directions by global scaling alone. The bath-only exp(−t/tau) identity is not a full-MD kinetic ACF. Statistical decisions apply to fixed seeds/budgets, not general mixing guarantees. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: A small example for one separable two-mode quartic potential and fixed seeds. H is not treated as harmonic Gamma. No independent exact full-system dynamical reference is claimed, and neither matching correlations nor time order hidden by sampling noise is an acceptance claim. Molecular transport, quantum and ab initio MD are outside scope.

title.ja: CSVRの厳密浴：条件付き分布・揺らぎ・運動エネルギー相関
title.en: Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation

summary.ja: 自由度1・2・6のCSVR浴だけを実装し、厳密な条件付きモーメントと非心χ²分布、正準Gamma分布と運動エネルギー相関を照合します。
summary.en: Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations.

assumptions.ja: kB=1、T=1.3、τ=0.5、h=0.2、65536独立複製。3初期Kと3自由度で条件付き分布を測定。Hamiltonianの力・座標・拘束・COM除去は含みません。
assumptions.en: kB=1, T=1.3, tau=0.5, h=0.2, 65536 independent replicas. Test three initial energies at each of three degree counts. No Hamiltonian force, positions, constraints or center-of-mass removal.

algorithm.ja: 平方完成した厳密CIR遷移を、標準正規Rと独立χ²(Nf−1)のSから作ります。同じRでglobal αの符号を決め、Nf=1ではS=0。単位方向と新しい半径からpを再構成し、極小KでKnew/Kを作りません。K=0は方向が未定義として拒否します。
algorithm.en: Use the completed-square exact CIR transition with normal R and independent chi-square(Nf−1) S. The same R sets the sign of global alpha; S=0 for Nf=1. Reconstruct momentum from its unit direction and new radius without a tiny-K energy ratio. Reject K=0 because its direction is undefined.

validation.ja: 条件付き平均・分散は独立なCIR式、CDFの3確率点はSciPyの非心χ²分位点、定常KはGamma分布、浴単独ACFはexp(−t/τ)と照合。無雑音の平均緩和は分散を失う対照として別表示します。
validation.en: Compare with separate CIR conditional moments, three SciPy noncentral-chi-square quantile probabilities, stationary Gamma K and bath-only exp(−t/tau) correlation. A separate noiseless mean-relaxation control demonstrates loss of fluctuations.

limits.ja: 浴の診断用ケースで独立した物理問題数へ加算しません。浴がKを正しく分布させてもglobal rescalingだけでは方向を熱化しません。exp(−t/τ)を力付きMDのK相関へ流用しません。固定seedと予算に対する統計判定で、一般の混合保証ではありません。
limits.en: A bath diagnostic, not another independent physical problem. Correct K sampling does not thermalize momentum directions by global scaling alone. The bath-only exp(−t/tau) identity is not a full-MD kinetic ACF. Statistical decisions apply to fixed seeds/budgets, not general mixing guarantees.

formulas: \bar K=\frac{N_fT}{2},\quad c=e^{-h/\tau},\quad A=\frac{T(1-c)}2,\quad R\sim N(0,1),\ S\sim\chi^2_{N_f-1}

summary.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 両方式とも厳密な浴O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2)（OBABO）。CSVRは全運動量に同じ係数、Langevinは各成分に独立OU雑音を作用。γ=1/(2τ)で自由浴のK緩和時間をそろえます。以前のBAOAB例は変更せず別の分割として残します。
algorithm.en: Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting.

validation.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
validation.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

limits.ja: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。
limits.en: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD.

summary.ja: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
summary.en: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), lambda=0.2, U=sum(omega²q²/2+lambda q⁴/4). Use 8192 canonical and 4096 heated replicas, t=20, tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05, lags 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 同じOBABO分割でglobal CSVRとlocal OUを比較。正準初期座標はGaussianを包絡にした独立棄却法、運動量はMaxwell分布から生成し、別の温度摂動初期集団も進めます。
algorithm.en: Compare global CSVR and local OU with the same OBABO splitting. Draw initial canonical positions by independent Gaussian-envelope rejection and momenta from Maxwell distributions, and evolve a separate heated initial ensemble.

validation.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
validation.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

limits.ja: 特定の分離可能な四次2自由度・固定seedだけの小さな例です。Hを調和系のGamma分布と扱いません。全系相関には独立な厳密動力学参照がなく、相関一致や統計誤差に隠れる時間次数を合格主張しません。成熟分子系・輸送係数・量子・第一原理MDの検証ではありません。
limits.en: A small example for one separable two-mode quartic potential and fixed seeds. H is not treated as harmonic Gamma. No independent exact full-system dynamical reference is claimed, and neither matching correlations nor time order hidden by sampling noise is an acceptance claim. Molecular transport, quantum and ab initio MD are outside scope.

title.en: Constraints,centre-of-mass removal and canonical statistics

summary.ja: 有効自由度、運動量共分散、過渡分布と時間相関を分けて検証します。
summary.en: Separate effectiveDOF,momentum covariance,transient distributions and time correlations.

assumptions.ja: 質量1/2/3の1D3粒子と1つの共通調和ポテンシャル。拘束なし・COM・COM＋相対・冗長行を含む同じ拘束でf=3/2/1/1、各1,024レプリカを用います。
assumptions.en: Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas.

algorithm.ja: 質量重み付き接空間でLangevin/CSVRをOBABO分割します。初期正準共分散からの有限時刻写像・雑音共分散を直接組み、連続参照と離散定常Lyapunov解を別に求めます。
algorithm.en: Apply tangent-space Langevin/CSVR in OBABO form. Build finite-time maps and noise covariance from canonical initial data; compute continuous references and stationary discrete Lyapunov solutions separately.

validation.ja: Fractionによる独立なrank/共分散、符号付きf1浴、正しい投影OU恒等式と誤ったambient自由度の負例を照合。220分布族、符号付き2時刻積、正しい/誤った温度分母を保存します。
validation.en: Check independent Fraction rank/covariance,signedf1 baths,the valid projectedOU identity and a wrong-ambientDOF counterexample. Retain220CDF families,signed two-time products and correct/incorrect temperature denominators.

limits.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
limits.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

summary.ja: 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。

assumptions.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。

assumptions: Autonomous additive initial-value problem with sufficiently smooth subflows on a fixed finite time interval.

methods.units: h has time units; F and G have units of state/time. For linear systems hA and hB are dimensionless. The oscillator illustration is nondimensional.
methods.units_ja: hは時間、FとGは状態/時間の単位。線形系ではhAとhBが無次元。教材の振動子は全変数を無次元化。
methods.boundary_conditions: None for the two-component ODE. PDEs need compatible stage boundary data; inhomogeneous or time-dependent boundaries can reduce order.
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 2成分ODEに空間境界条件はない。PDEでは部分問題・段階の境界値を整合させる。非同次・時間依存境界では次数低下を確認。

limitations.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。
limitations.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.

summary.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
summary.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic.

algorithm.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
algorithm.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

validation.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
validation.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

Use exact subflows or subsolvers with sufficient order and compatible boundaries; symmetric subsolvers are needed for time symmetry.
assumptions_ja: 自律的で加法的な初期値問題。固定した有限時間区間で部分流と解に十分な滑らかさがある。
表示した大域次数には安定性と十分小さい刻みが必要。
厳密流または必要な次数・境界整合性を持つ部分ソルバーを用いる。時間対称性には対称な部分ソルバーも必要。
methods.units: h has time units; F and G have units of state/time. For linear systems hA and hB are dimensionless. The oscillator illustration is nondimensional.
methods.units_ja: hは時間、FとGは状態/時間の単位。線形系ではhAとhBが無次元。教材の振動子は全変数を無次元化。
methods.boundary_conditions: None for the two-component ODE. PDEs need compatible stage boundary data; inhomogeneous or time-dependent boundaries can reduce order.
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 2成分ODEに空間境界条件はない。PDEでは部分問題・段階の境界値を整合させる。非同次・時間依存境界では次数低下を確認。

limitations.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
limitations.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

title.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
title.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

summary.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
summary.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic.

algorithm.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
algorithm.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

validation.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
validation.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

limits.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
limits.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

title.ja: Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正
title.en: Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction

summary.ja: 実1D非周期場で、未補正/境界補正Strangを同じFD参照へ比較し、時間誤差と空間誤差を分けます。
summary.en: Evolve actual one-dimensional nonperiodic fields and compare unmodified and boundary-corrected Strang splitting against the same spatial discretization.

assumptions.ja: u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。
assumptions.en: Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.

algorithm.ja: w=u−1で未補正(Lw,w+1)、補正(Lw+1,w)に分割。実DirichletDST-I指数流を合成し、反応の境界不整合を保持します。
algorithm.en: For w = u - 1, use the unmodified split (Lw, w + 1) or the corrected split (Lw + 1, w). Compose actual Dirichlet DST-I flows and retain the reaction boundary mismatch.

validation.ja: 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。
validation.en: First qualify an independent sparse affine exponential action against separately written sine sums. Then separate temporal error against the same finite-difference system, spatial error against the analytic continuum field, and observed order in the fixed regime.

limits.ja: 原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。

title.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓
title.en: Coupled frequencies and finite-window resonance

summary.ja: 2自由度の実結合系で、12の64刻みprobeと6の精度軌道を使い、真のモード、座標間交換、離散写像と丸めを分けます。
summary.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.

assumptions.ja: α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。
assumptions.en: alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi.

algorithm.ja: 全ポテンシャルVerletと、B半kick・A厳密flow・B半kickのStrang impulse。Aには高速調和振動子と低速自由流、Bには低速位置項と結合を含めます。
algorithm.en: Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.

validation.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。
validation.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.

limits.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
limits.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

title.ja: Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
title.en: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

summary.ja: 2つのNeumann摂動とDirichlet摂動を独立な非線形Galerkin参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare two Neumann perturbations and a Dirichlet perturbation against nonlinear Galerkin references.

assumptions.ja: [0,2π]²、T=2、a=0.1,b=0.9,Du=0.01,Dv=1。平衡(1,0.9)のまわりで3初期値と12/24/48セル、一定の非周期境界を使います。
assumptions.en: On[0,2π]² toT2,use a.1,b.9,Du.01,Dv1. Compare three perturbations of(1,.9),12/24/48cell grids and fixed nonperiodic boundary conditions.

algorithm.ja: セル平均のCN拡散と局所陰的中点反応をStrang分割します。独立参照は正規直交sin/cos Galerkin、K12/18,Q96/192と2許容誤差の4列を全初期値で残します。 元のDirichlet K12/18参照は初回の相対資格基準を満たさなかったため、失敗を残し、D境界だけK24/32・Q128/192の4参照を追加します。
algorithm.en: Strang-split cell-averageCN diffusion and local implicit-midpoint reactions. Independent orthonormal sine/cosine Galerkin references retain four K12/18,Q96/192,tolerance rows for every initial condition. The original Dirichlet K12/18 reference failed its first relative qualification. Preserve that failure and add four D-only K24/32,Q128/192 reference actions.

validation.ja: 線形モードの連続・離散記号、角の面所有、平衡、物質収支を照合。K/Q/時間許容差感度を別に測り、参照が資格条件を満たさなければ精度・次数を未確定にします。 精度目標には、新しい細参照が同じ絶対・相対基準に合格した場合だけその参照を用います。旧参照の不合格を合格へ読み替えません。
validation.en: Check continuum/discrete linear symbols, corner-face ownership, equilibrium and mass ledgers. Separate K/Q/tolerance sensitivity; unqualified references leave related accuracy/order unresolved. Use the new finer reference for accuracy goals only after the same absolute/relative criteria pass; the original failed qualification is retained.

name.ja: レベルセット法

summary.ja: 界面をφ=0で表し、Hamilton–Jacobi型の方程式で移流・法線運動を扱う。専用の2D円の平行移動・偏心剛体回転をENO2＋Heunで検証し、面積誤差と再初期化の影響を比較する。

title.ja: レベルセット円の2D平行移動：界面・面積・再初期化
title.en: 2D level-set circle translation: interface, area and redistancing

summary.ja: 中心(.3,.35)の半径.15の円を速度(.2,.1)でT=1まで平行移動します。32²/64²/128²のENO2＋Heunを用い、再初期化の有無、途中の界面位置、面積誤差と格子・刻みの細分化を比べます。
summary.en: Translate a radius.15 circle from(.3,.35) at velocity(.2,.1) toT=1. ENO2/Heun on32²/64²/128² grids compares optional redistancing, intermediate interfaces, geometric area and coupled grid/time refinement.

assumptions.ja: 全て無次元、領域[0,1]²、内部φ<0。与えた非圧縮の剛体運動だけを解き、円は境界から離れます。外側2層のゴースト値は各RK段階で解析解を指定します。周期境界ではなく、内部のφは数値更新します。出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1、物理Courant数max(|u|+|v|)Δt/Δx≤.35。
assumptions.en: All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35.

algorithm.ja: 移流は両モードで同じ2次ENO片側微分とHeun RK2。2階差分の絶対値でステンシルを選択します。再初期化ありでは物理時刻.1ごとに、呼出し開始時の平滑符号を固定した1次Godunov法をΔτ=.3Δxで5回実行。体積補正、界面への投影、φのclip、隠れたretry、内部の解析解への置換を行いません。
algorithm.en: Both modes use the same second-order ENO one-sided differences and Heun RK2, selecting stencils by absolute second differences. Optional redistancing occurs every.1 physical time: five first-order Godunov steps, dtau=.3dx, with the smoothed sign frozen per call. There is no volume correction, interface projection, phi clipping, hidden retry or analytic interior reset.

validation.ja: 解析的な円の中心運動と符号付き距離を参照し、4つの正の共通時刻の最悪値を測定します。界面位置は格子辺上で線形補間したφ=0点の半径誤差、面積は格子中心間を三角形に分けた区分線形φの負領域から計算。初期の幾何学的な面積偏りも残します。|φ厳密|≤2Δx帯のφ誤差と距離勾配、各再初期化による面積変化、N64でのCourant半減も別記録。
validation.en: Analytic center motion and signed distance provide the reference. Take worst errors over the four positive common observation times. Interface error samples linearly interpolated grid-edge zeros; area comes from the negative portion of a piecewise-linear triangulation between grid centers, retaining initial geometric bias. Also record phi error and distance-gradient quality in|phi_exact|<=2dx, each redistancing area jump and a separateN64 CFL-halving sensitivity.

limits.ja: 辺上の半径誤差はHausdorff距離ではなく、ΔxとΔtを同時に細分化した観測次数は純粋な空間次数と区別します。再初期化で面積や位置が改善するとは限らず、本例では最細格子でも誤差が増えます。VOFとの数値的な優劣比較、独立PDEエンジン、界面の合体分裂、曲率流・表面張力・二相Navier–Stokesは検証していません。2モードは同じ円の移流問題の追加条件です。
limits.en: Sampled radial error is not a Hausdorff distance. Observed order refines dx and dt together rather than isolating spatial order. Redistancing need not improve area or position; errors increase here even on the finest grid. No numerical VOF ranking, separate PDE engine, topology change, curvature flow, surface tension or two-phase Navier–Stokes validation is claimed. The two motions are conditions of one transported-circle-interface problem.

assumptions.en: All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35.

algorithm.ja: 移流は両モードで同じ2次ENO片側微分とHeun RK2。2階差分の絶対値でステンシルを選択します。再初期化ありでは物理時刻.1ごとに、呼出し開始時の平滑符号を固定した1次Godunov法をΔτ=.3Δxで5回実行。体積補正、界面への投影、φのclip、隠れたretry、内部の解析解への置換を行いません。
algorithm.en: Both modes use the same second-order ENO one-sided differences and Heun RK2, selecting stencils by absolute second differences. Optional redistancing occurs every.1 physical time: five first-order Godunov steps, dtau=.3dx, with the smoothed sign frozen per call. There is no volume correction, interface projection, phi clipping, hidden retry or analytic interior reset.

validation.ja: 解析的な円の中心運動と符号付き距離を参照し、4つの正の共通時刻の最悪値を測定します。界面位置は格子辺上で線形補間したφ=0点の半径誤差、面積は格子中心間を三角形に分けた区分線形φの負領域から計算。初期の幾何学的な面積偏りも残します。|φ厳密|≤2Δx帯のφ誤差と距離勾配、各再初期化による面積変化、N64でのCourant半減も別記録。
validation.en: Analytic center motion and signed distance provide the reference. Take worst errors over the four positive common observation times. Interface error samples linearly interpolated grid-edge zeros; area comes from the negative portion of a piecewise-linear triangulation between grid centers, retaining initial geometric bias. Also record phi error and distance-gradient quality in|phi_exact|<=2dx, each redistancing area jump and a separateN64 CFL-halving sensitivity.

limits.ja: 辺上の半径誤差はHausdorff距離ではなく、ΔxとΔtを同時に細分化した観測次数は純粋な空間次数と区別します。再初期化で面積や位置が改善するとは限らず、本例では最細格子でも誤差が増えます。VOFとの数値的な優劣比較、独立PDEエンジン、界面の合体分裂、曲率流・表面張力・二相Navier–Stokesは検証していません。2モードは同じ円の移流問題の追加条件です。
limits.en: Sampled radial error is not a Hausdorff distance. Observed order refines dx and dt together rather than isolating spatial order. Redistancing need not improve area or position; errors increase here even on the finest grid. No numerical VOF ranking, separate PDE engine, topology change, curvature flow, surface tension or two-phase Navier–Stokes validation is claimed. The two motions are conditions of one transported-circle-interface problem.

validation.ja: 追加のGauss点で連続L2誤差を積分し、既存DGの最終多項式と共通点で照合。全RK段階の重み付き質量と各完了ステップの2次エネルギーを検査。同じFR空間演算子の行列指数解で時間誤差を別測定し、刻み半減を確認。
validation.en: Integrate continuous L2 error at additional Gauss points and compare final polynomials with the actual published DG at common points. Check weighted mass at every RK stage and quadratic energy at each completed step. A matrix exponential of the same FR operator separately measures RK3 time error and its timestep-halving response.

limits.ja: このRadau/Gauss・線形一定流束・アフィン要素の設定がDGに対応します。全FRと全DGの同値性、非線形流束・衝撃波・制限器・多次元FRは保証しません。hとΔtの同時細分化と行列指数による空間誤差を分け、行列指数を独立した空間PDEソルバーとは呼びません。PyFR本体は未実行。

summary.en: Actually solve variable-viscosity stress divergence on an annulus; check velocity, strain, physical traction and work.

assumptions.ja: 1≤r≤2、theta周期、mu=1+.2r²、lambda=0、両円でu=0。A(s)=(s−1)(4−s)、u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2)。Nr8/16/32、Ntheta=2Nr。
assumptions.en: 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr.

algorithm.ja: polarのmapped Q1にCartesian速度2成分を置き、r dr dthetaで2mu epsilonの弱形式を4×4 Gauss積分してblock疎解法。円周faceにはr dthetaと外向き法線を使う。
algorithm.en: Mapped polar Q1 with two Cartesian velocity components;4×4 Gauss integration of2mu epsilon uses exact r dr dtheta metric, followed by a block sparse solve. Circular traction uses r dtheta and outward normals.

validation.ja: 独自解析外力を別のCartesian応力差分で資格確認。L2速度/歪み/traction細分化、反力/体積外力と物理tractionの収支、粘性散逸と外力仕事を別々に測定。 体積外力の解析積分(756pi/5,0)も別に照合。
validation.en: Qualify the derived force by separate Cartesian stress differentiation. Measure velocity/strain/traction refinement, reactions versus volume-force/physical traction budgets, and viscous dissipation versus force work. Also check the independently integrated body force (756pi/5,0).

limits.ja: 線形vector粘性BVPです。divfree拘束・圧力・非線形Navier–Stokesは含めません。原点なしのr>0であり、軸stencil検証ではありません。
limits.en: A linear vector viscous BVP, without divergence-free constraint, pressure or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. r>0 only; no axis stencil certification.
